Yosef — the tzadik from whom holiness of Eretz Yisrael is drawn, where there is doubled abundance — said to his brothers who blemished his honor, disputed and sold him: "You are meraglim" — your blemish is the blemish of the meraglim . When one blemishes the tzadik's honor, one blemishes Eretz Yisrael . "The nakedness of the land" — disgrace, the opposite of his'pa'arus . They did not want to see Yosef's beauty and his'pa'arus ; they came to see nakedness, the opposite. Because of this, the seven years of famine — the desire for money — prevailed. All from the blemish of the meraglim , the blemish of Eretz Yisrael , the blemish of the tzadik's honor. Yaakov, hearing "you are meraglim ," understood. He told them: "and kesef mishneh take in your hand" — doubled abundance. He commanded them to draw the doubled abundance from Eretz Yisrael . § 18 — Tzedakah on Chanukah; the Oil That Never Runs Out This is the tzedakah given on Chanukah — to rectify the desire for money, to draw doubled abundance from Eretz Yisrael , the source of blessing. This is the Chanukah oil — "oil upon your head shall not be lacking" — "not lacking" specifically, no lack there — "the jar of oil shall not be lacking." Oil is mochin , holy anointing oil. Through mind and da'as , a person lacks nothing: "if you acquired da'as, what do you lack?" (Nedarim 41). This itself is the miracle of Chanukah — blessing sent into the small oil, burning eight days — blessed doubled abundance from Eretz Yisrael , for on Chanukah we draw holiness of Eretz Yisrael . § 19 — " Mikaitz ": Money-Desire as Darkness; Meraglim and Pharaoh "And it was at the end [mikaitz] of two years, and Pharaoh dreamed." Mikaitz — the desire for money: "He set a limit [kaitz] to darkness — this i

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaMazon 4 Part3b
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hamazon Part b Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaMazon U'Mayim Acharonim — Halachah 4 Part 3b (§§ 20–24) — FINAL COMPLETE · Based on LM II:40 § 20 — Ratzon Is the Essential Avodah ; Birchas HaZimun Let us return to Birchas HaMazon . The essential mitzvah of Birchas HaMazon is to reveal and draw the holiness of Eretz Yisrael — "and you shall eat and be satisfied and bless Hashem your G-d for the good land." This holiness is drawn through the his'pa'arus revealed at the table — the cup of Birchas HaMazon , as explained above at length. This is Birchas HaZimun — when three are present, they say "let us bless [the One] from Whose [bounty] we have eaten" before Birchas HaMazon — inviting [ mezamnin ] themselves to bless. The matter is: the essential holiness and avodah of the Jewish person is only the ratzon and kisufin of holiness, as explained in many places in Rabbainu's words. As he said: to serve Hashem — no one can boast that he can serve Him. Even an angel, even a seraph , cannot boast of this. The essential thing is the ratzon and kisufin — one must exert oneself to always have strong desires and great yearnings for Hashem's service. (As this teaching is explained somewhat at the end of Sipurai Ma'asiyos .) And more than this we heard from his holy mouth regarding the greatness of holy ratzon , which is the essential avodas Hashem . All avodos — Torah, prayer, mitzvos , good deeds — are all included in this. It is impossible to merit anything holy except through ratzon , desire, yearning, kisufin , and pining. One must never weaken the ratzon in any way. The more the obstacle grows, one should strengthen oneself with ever stronger desire and kisufin and ratzonos — until one brings it from potential to actuality. As explained in "Vihi Na Pi Shenayim" ( Siman 66 ): the obstacle exists only for the desire. If one strengthens one's desire to match the obstacle, one will certainly break it. It emerges: the essential strengthening to overcome obstacles is only ratzon and desire. This is the essential his'pa'arus — from Israel's azus and stubbornness, through which Torah was received. The essential stubbornness is in ratzon . One must be a great stubborn person in ratzon — never abandoning, never weakening it through any obstacle. This is the essential holy stubbornness. This is the essential his'pa'arus . For in truth, the avodah itself is not so precious — everything is from Him: "who has preceded Me that I should repay?" We cannot do anything holy without His help: "every day the yetzer overpowers, and were it not that Hashem helps, he would fall." Therefore the essential his'pa'arus is in the ratzon — that each Jew desires with a strong ratzon to serve Him. Even if one is the greatest stubborn person, there are certainly unbreakable obstacles — imprisonment, illness, and the like. Similarly regarding traveling to Eretz Yisrael : if the sea stands before him with no ship, no money, or it is wartime — what good is stubbornness? One cannot jump into the sea; not everyone merits that Hashem split it for him. Therefore the essential stubbornness is only in ratzon — come what may, never weaken the ratzon . Even with thousands of seemingly unbreakable obstacles, one should do one's part and desire with ever stronger ratzon — for the desire must match the obstacle ( Siman 66 ). If one is a great stubborn person in ratzon , never abandoning the kisufin no matter how far one falls chas v'shalom — then ultimately Hashem will certainly help break and nullify all obstacles, provide everything needed for the journey to Eretz Yisrael or any holy matter, and turn things to good. For the obstacle existed only for the desire — the essential test being whether one abandons the ratzon . When one stands firm and never abandons it, the obstacles transform into salvations. It emerges: the essential stubbornness is in ratzon . This is the essential his'pa'arus . This is "set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm, for love is as strong as death" — "as a seal upon your heart, upon your arm" is the aspect of tefillin , as stated in the holy Zohar. Tefillin are the his'pa'arus — Hashem takes pride in Israel and sets them as a seal upon His heart. The essential his'pa'arus that forms this seal of tefillin is made through the love, yearning, ratzon , and kisufin of Israel. "Set me as a seal" — tefillin , his'pa'arus — "for love is as strong as death" — our love and ratzon for You is fierce and strong with great azus and stubbornness. Therefore it is fitting for You to take pride in us, for this is the essential his'pa'arus . "Love is as strong as death, jealousy as hard as the grave." Love — ratzon and desire and yearning for Hashem — through which the essential overcoming of the Sitra Achra , which is the side of death, from which all obstacles come. According to the Sitra Achra's strengthening, so must one's love and ratzon be strong — the desire must ma

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaMazon 5 Part1
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hamazon Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaMazon U'Mayim Acharonim — Halachah 5 Part 1 of 2 (§§ 1–5) COMPLETE FULL TRANSLATION Based on LM I:28 — "B'ni Lan Baisa" Fallen alafin ; fallen Toros ; hachnasas orchim ; the Mishkan traveling through the desert Halachic framework : Based on the Torah "Build us a house" ( Siman 28, Likutay I ) — see the entire Torah there. The general principle: the misnagdim [opponents], etc. — this is because they receive Torah from talmidai chachamim who are "demons in the form of Jews," etc. — who have fallen Torah from fallen alafin [thousands/letters alef ]. Regarding these alafin it is written about Shlomo: "and he spoke three thousand parables, and his songs were a thousand and five" — for Shlomo merited them in holiness. But a talmid chacham who is a "demon in Jewish form," etc. — it emerges that through this, people fall into great kefiros [heresies], etc. The remedy for this is "I am a worm and not a man, the disgrace of mankind" — the aspect of a worm, through which one defeats one's enemies, for the worm is the aspect of emunah [faith], etc. This is the aspect of Avraham, etc. For Avraham — who is Chesed , the aspect of emunah — with this right hand he overcomes his enemies, etc. Through this Chesed , the fallen alafin are rectified, in the aspect of "and does kindness to thousands [la'alafim]." To come to Chesed , one can only come through bringing talmidai chachamim who are tzadikim into one's house — which is as though one offered the korban tamid , as our Sages said. And tamid has the gematria of four alafin — which is the tikkun of the alafin , etc. This is what the Elder of the Academy said: "Build us a house in the air of the world" — for these people want to establish their avodah through the Torah they hear from such talmidai chachamim , but in truth they have nothing to rely on — it is as if they want to build a house in the air, etc. And he said: "and he stood between heaven and earth" — the true talmid chacham is between heaven and earth, etc. — see all this there well. All of this is the secret of the intent of Parshas HaTamid — see there well and you will understand. You will see the wonders of the One of perfect knowledge — how He concealed within this the secret intent of the Tamid in a new, wondrous, and awesome way, in His exalted manner, about which it is impossible to speak at all, except to one who is wise and understands the truth on his own. We will not elaborate here. § 1 — Birchas HaMazon After Eating: Sorting the Good from the Pesoless This is the aspect of the mitzvah of Birchas HaMazon after eating. For the essence of all birchos hanehenin [blessings over enjoyments] — and especially Birchas HaMazon , which is the main one, being d'Oraisa , from which all other berachos were derived, as our Sages said: "If he blesses afterward, certainly he should bless beforehand" — the essence of all blessings over food is to sort the berurim [clarifications/sortings]. Through the sin of Adam HaRishon — whose sin was in eating — everything became mixed up, and it was decreed: "by the sweat of your brow you shall eat bread... in sorrow you shall eat." Therefore great toil is needed before one merits to eat in holiness — to sort the food from the kelipah and pesoless [waste/chaff] clinging to it through Adam's sin. This is the aspect of all the blessings over food — to sort the good from the food and expel the pesoless outward. This is Birchas HaMazon , the foundation of all birchos hanehenin — to sort the food. The essential sorting is to extract the good in the food — whose connection is from the Torah drawn through true tzadikim — and to expel the pesoless derived from the Torah of the blemished talmidai chachamim mentioned above, who have fallen Torah from the four fallen alafin . For the food gives life to a person — this is palpably evident. The essential vitality certainly does not come from the bread itself, but from the divine vitality, which is the vitality of Torah clothed within the bread, as it is written: "for not by bread alone does man live," etc. The essential vitality is from Torah: "for it is your life." Therefore the power and vitality in food to sustain a person comes through the holy Torah. But through Adam's sin, good and evil became mixed in all things. For in the bread and food there is also the grip of pesoless derived from the fallen Toros mentioned above — the aspect of the advice of the Serpent: "the Serpent deceived me." This is blemished and corrupting teaching that is not truthful — that has no power to guide a person on the straight path. All this derives from Adam's sin. For the essence of his sin was also through blemished fallen Toros — the aspect of the Serpent's counsel. For the Serpent came upon him with great cunning and deception — teaching the woman and Adam a very deep and profound teaching, in a way of wondrous wisdom and intellect, until he decei

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaMazon 5 Part2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hamazon Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaMazon U'Mayim Acharonim — Halachah 5 Part 2 of 2 (§§ 6–9) — FINAL COMPLETE · Based on LM I:28 § 5 (conclusion) — " Vayehi Binso'a HaAron " This is: "and it was, when the Aron traveled, Moshe said: 'Rise, Hashem, and let Your enemies be scattered and Your foes flee before You.'" The enemies and foes mentioned above — the misnagdim of truth who are nourished by the fallen Toros — flee and are nullified through the traveling of the Aron . For through this the aforementioned Toros were sorted and elevated, and the nourishment of the enemies and foes was nullified of itself. This is: "and when it rested, he said: 'Return, Hashem, the myriads of the thousands [alfai] of Israel.'" "Alfai" specifically — the aspect of the alafin that return and rest when the Aron rests in its place. Then the alafin that were sorted return and rest in their place in peace, for they were once again made into holy Torah. § 6 — Hachnasas Orchim : Hosting Righteous Guests Restores Fallen Torah For this very reason, the essential tikkun to elevate the fallen Toros mentioned above is through hachnasas orchim — hosting righteous guests — as above. For the righteous guest who walks and travels on the road, who is unsettled and wandering — all his wandering is for the aforementioned purpose: to sort and rectify avira d'alma , which is the fallen Toros. This is "and they followed at Your feet, bearing Your word" — and our Sages expounded: "these are the talmidai chachamim who go and wear out their feet from city to city, engaging in the word of G-d." All their wandering — wearing out their feet — is for the word of G-d, to sort the aforementioned Toros. Therefore when a person merits to host this righteous guest, bringing him into his home and honoring him properly — he gives rest to the fallen Toros that the tzadik was engaged in sorting during his road-traveling and wandering. For now, when he enters a house and finds a place to rest, he builds in completeness wondrous structures from the fallen Toros he gathered and sorted on his journey. This is exactly like the resting of the Aron and Mishkan , when it was said: "Return, Hashem, the myriads of the alfai of Israel." For wherever the tzadik goes, the Shechinah and Torah go with him, just as they went with Israel and the Aron in the midbar . It emerges: one who hosts this guest in his home gives an actual resting place to the Toros that were sorted through him. Therefore specifically through this, one rectifies and elevates the fallen alafin , for they are exactly one aspect. As it is written: "and he went around to Bais El and the Gilgal and the Mitzpah... and his return was to Ramah, for there was his house" (Shmuel I, 7). Our Sages expounded: "wherever he went, there was his house." For Shmuel went around to all these places to sort the alafin — for this is the purpose of all the tzadikim's wanderings. And this is "his return was to Ramah, for there was his house" — wherever he went, there was his house. For wherever he came, he brought the fallen Toros from avira d'alma into the aspect of "house." Therefore wherever he came — there was his house. § 7 — The Bais HaMikdash and Shlomo; the Corruption That Destroyed It Therefore the essential completeness of the tikkun was in the Bais HaMikdash — the essential House standing in its place, baisa bain shamaya l'ar'a . There the essential Torah [resides]. Therefore specifically Shlomo built the Bais HaMikdash , for Shlomo merited these alafin in holiness — "and he spoke three thousand parables," etc. — as explained in the Torah . Therefore he specifically merited to build the House where the essential permanence of true Torah resides — the aspect of these alafin in holiness. But ba'avonosainu harabim [through our many sins], even then purification was not yet complete from the Serpent's counsel. The ba'al davar so greatly provoked that afterward he deceived Israel through evil teachings — through Yarav'am and his cohorts and the false prophets, who all drew from the fallen Toros — until sins prevailed and the House was destroyed. For there are many levels in these evil teachings: some twist truth entirely, some deviate slightly, some deviate so minutely it is impossible to detect. The ba'al davar greatly provokes specifically against talmidai chachamim — even great tzadikim can sometimes err through the fallen Toros that turn their minds from truth. Therefore even Shlomo HaMelech himself — who merited the four alafin in holiness and truly merited to build the House — yet immediately when he began building, the ba'al davar was very jealous and provoked him until he too was deceived through evil teachings, until he married Pharaoh's daughter and foreign women. All this came through blemished teachings — he said to Isiel and Uchal (Mishlai 30) and wanted to outsmart the Torah of Moshe which says "he shall not multiply wives." As he lat

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaMazon Halachah 3
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hamazon Halachah Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim Hilchos Birchas HaMazon U'Mayim Acharonim Halachah 3 (§§ 1–16) Based on LM I:34 ( "V'Atem Tihyu Li Mamleches Kohanim" ) Introduction: The Three Nekudos and the Broken Heart "Disgrace has broken my heart" (Tehillim 69) — disgraces and humiliations shatter a person's heart. The tikkun is to connect one's heart to the nekudah [holy point] relevant to one's heart at that time. The tzadik rules — his essential dominion is to illuminate and awaken hearts for Hashem's service: "Yosef is the ruler." This aspect of "Yosef the ruler" = mala fum — the tzadik 's mouth is full of Hashem's holiness. Therefore one must pray aloud, with the mouth, not thought alone. The essential framework: the tzadik is the comprehensive nekudah — the root of all Israel's souls. Initially, everyone must receive from the tzadik . Afterward, each person receives from his fellow — for every Jew has a unique precious point that his fellow lacks, and regarding that point he is a " tzadik " toward his fellow. One receives this by conversing with friends about yiras Shamayim . Finally, each person receives from within himself ( minei u'vei ) — illuminating his own nekudah by speaking between himself and his Creator: "my mouth speaks wisdom" — the nekudah in the mouth illuminates the heart. Through these three nekudos , the disgraces besieging the heart are annulled. All evil desires come from the shattering of the vessels of Chesed — from there all fallen loves, and from there all "disgraces of the heart." When one connects the heart to the nekudah = tzadik : "love covers all transgressions." At the nekudah , holy love dwells = Kohein : "I give him My covenant of peace" (said of Pinchas when he received the kehunah ). The Kohein = holy love dwelling at the bris = the tzadik = the nekudah . Through this, fallen loves are nullified. § 1 — Birchas HaMazon: Connecting the Heart to the Nekudah This is Birchas HaMazon . Everything a person eats and enjoys contains fallen loves that must be elevated and connected to holy love — "love in delights" : all the world's pleasures must be raised to holy love. This is accomplished by connecting the heart to the nekudah = tzadik . All berachos the Sages established — forbidding benefit without a berachah — serve this purpose: through the berachah , one connects the heart to the nekudah , the source of all blessings: "blessings upon the head of the tzadik ." Birchas HaMazon is the root from which the Sages derived all berachos : "if one blesses afterward, how much more so beforehand!" The essential clarification of food occurs after eating — the good rises to the heart, the finest to the brain, the waste is expelled. Birchas HaMazon after eating ensures this clarification happens in holiness, connecting the heart to the nekudah in the mouth. Therefore Birchas HaMazon is specifically on bread: "bread sustains the heart" — the heart needs the most clarification from fallen loves. Three berachos connect the heart to the nekudah . "He ate and drank, and his heart was gladdened" — this is Birchas HaMazon . Through it, the heart's evil (= fallen loves, broken heart) is annulled. The nekudah = tzadik = good: "say of the tzadik : he is good." Therefore: "his heart was gladdened" through Birchas HaMazon . § 2 — Yosef the Ruler: Source of All Blessings and Satiation All sustenance and blessings flow from the tzadik = "Yosef is the ruler over the land; he is the provider to all the people of the land." Yosef = the seven years of plenty, subduing the seven years of famine = "disgrace of famine" ( cherpas ra'av ). Yosef sustains the entire world during famine: "G-d has gathered my disgrace" — said of Yosef, who gathers and nullifies all disgrace. Pharaoh told the people: "Go to Yosef; whatever he tells you, do." Rashi: they had stored grain but it rotted. Yosef told them to circumcise themselves. "If he decreed on the grain and it rotted — what if he decrees on us and we die?" — for Yosef = tzadik moshel [the ruling tzadik ]; whoever distances from the nekudah is far from blessing, and the years of famine overpower. All life comes only from the tzadik = "the tzadik — the life of all worlds." Even Yaakov and his sons — "Your people are all tzadikim " — could not receive sustenance except through Yosef, the comprehensive nekudah . Yaakov said: "go, buy us grain to break our hunger." " Shever " [grain/breaking] specifically — for the hunger comes from sheviras lev [heartbreak] = "disgrace has broken my heart" = cherpas ra'av . The tikkun : through Yosef, who brings satiation: "the tzadik eats to satisfy his soul." This is Birchas HaMazon : drawing blessing and satiation — "you shall eat, be satisfied, and bless." The Zohar: "Can one not be satisfied [without the blessing]? Rather, even if a person eats a little, and places the will of satiation upon it…" — the essential satiation comes through Birchas HaMazon itself, connecting the heart to

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaMazon Halachos 1-2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hamazon Halachos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim Hilchos Birchas HaMazon U'Mayim Acharonim Halachos 1–2 Halachah 1 Based on LM I:17 ( "Vayhi Heim Merikim" ) and LM I:47 ( "Va'Achaltem Achol" ) As explained above in Hilchos Netilas Yadayim and Betzi'as HaPas , Halachah 1: eating is the aspect of drawing da'as [holy awareness]. Rabbainu also writes in LM I:17 that through eating, the da'as is completed. Mayim Acharonim: Sustaining the Da'as Therefore one must wash mayim acharonim [final waters] after eating, in order to give the Sitra Achra its share, as is known — for its primary sustenance comes from the table/altar. One must give them sustenance in a measured way so they do not overpower and — Heaven forbid — destroy the da'as entirely. Mayim acharonim = the sustaining of the da'as : without it, they would overpower. The Sages linked the two washings, calling them mayim rishonim and mayim acharonim , for both serve one purpose: mayim rishonim purify the hands so as to draw the da'as ; mayim acharonim , after the da'as has been drawn through eating, give the Sitra Achra its due to sustain the da'as . "You shall sanctify yourselves [ v'hiskadishtem ]" = mayim rishonim ; "and you shall be holy [ vi'hyisem kedoshim ]" = mayim acharonim . Both are holiness, for the essence of holiness is the da'as . " V'hiskadishtem " = active sanctification, becoming holy anew = drawing da'as through mayim rishonim . " Vi'hyisem " = a state of enduring holiness, ensuring it persists = mayim acharonim that sustains the da'as . Mayim acharonim may be performed with any liquid (not specifically water): mayim rishonim , which draw the da'as , require raising the hands and a berachah — therefore they need actual water (= da'as ). But mayim acharonim only need to remove contamination and give the Sitra Achra its portion — no water specifically required, no raising of hands, no berachah . Birchas HaMazon: Connecting to the Tzadik Immediately after mayim acharonim — having achieved the completion of the da'as — one merits Birchas HaMazon . Through the complete da'as , one binds oneself to the tzadik (as in LM I:17 ). When bound to the tzadik , all blessings flow: "blessings upon the head of the tzadik ." This is Birchas HaMazon : drawing blessings through the tzadik by binding to him through eating = the completion of da'as . The orach [guest] blesses = "the path of the tzadikim is like light." Therefore: immediately after mayim acharonim — bless! ( Tichef li'netilah berachah. ) One must not pause at all after giving the Sitra Achra its portion, lest it overpower. Flee immediately to the berachah = binding to the tzadik . Birchas HaMazon in Any Language Birchas HaMazon may be said in any language. After eating properly with mayim rishonim , mayim acharonim , and eating in holiness — the sustenance of all the seventy nations' kelippos and false beliefs is nullified. The da'as is perfected; converts are made; all seventy languages return to holiness. Therefore one may bless in any language — all are now holy. One should also feed the poor from one's table — especially during the meal — so that converts are made and the altar/table is perfected (as in LM I:17 ). The essential tzedakah = giving to a talmid chacham , especially during eating: this is hachnasos orchim [hospitality] for Torah scholars = "the path of tzadikim " = binding to the tzadik . Three Berachos of Birchas HaMazon The three berachos of Birchas HaMazon correspond to the da'as (which encompasses three: yirah and ahavah = Chesed and Gevurah , united by Da'as ). Therefore three berachos suffice mi'd'Oraysa . The middle berachah ( Birchas HaAretz ) = the tzadik : "the tzadikim shall inherit the land," and bris is mentioned there = tzadik . The first berachah ( HaZan ) = ahavah /desire — it speaks of Hashem's goodness, kindness, mercy, and will. The third ( Boneh Yerushalayim ) = yirah = yirah shalem [complete awe]. Through binding to the tzadik through eating, one merits both yirah and ahavah . The Sages added a fourth berachah — HaTov V'HaMeitiv — to extend the da'as into its detailed expression (four aspects in detail, though three in essence). Avraham's Eshel "He planted an eshel in Be'er Sheva and called there in the Name of Hashem." Through eating and drinking (= eshel , as Rashi explains), Avraham called in Hashem's Name — for through eating, yirah and ahavah are revealed. Avraham, the man of chesed and tzedakah , made converts — and through this merited the perfected altar/table. ✦ ✦ ✦ Halachah 2 Based on LM I:47 ( "Va'Achaltem Achol V'Savo'a" ) Halachic framework : Zimun [invitation to bless] with three; the cup of wine for Birchas HaMazon — the essential cup is with three (Zohar; Shulchan Aruch ). Breaking the Desire for Eating = Truth = Eretz Yisrael From LM I:47 : through breaking the desire for eating, one merits emes [truth] and can perform wonders. The Sages: "Shall I not show favor to Israel? I said: 'you shall eat, be s

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 1-2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachos 1 & 2 COMPLETE FULL TRANSLATION Halachah 1 — Sparks in Food; Bless the Favorite First Halachah: If one has many types of fruit before him, one blesses the most cherished first — except for the Seven Species. See the Shulchan Aruch for the laws ( Siman 211 ). Also, borai pri ha'aitz takes precedence over borai pri ha'adamah , etc. Rabbainu nero ya'ir writes (in the Torah "Vayehi Mikaitz — Zikaron," Siman 54 ) that Hashem arranges for every person each day and each hour to elevate sparks according to the portions of nefesh , ruach , and neshamah he has then — see there. In edible things, holy souls are especially clothed. Hashem arranges for each person to eat the foods connected to his portions of nefesh , ruach , and neshamah at that time, to complete his soul. This is why we bless: "Who creates many souls and their deficiencies [v'chesronam]" — "their deficiencies" specifically — for these souls one now eats are the sparks that were lacking from one's soul and fell there. Now, through eating, one completes one's soul's actual deficiency. Sometimes a person has no deficiency in his soul, but through eating he elevates souls from there, illuminating and enlivening his soul with additional radiance. This is: "for everything He created to enliven with them the soul of every living being" — as the commentator explains: even without these things one could survive; they are only to enliven further, to add vitality and radiance to one's soul. Therefore one blesses the most cherished first. Every thing draws itself toward its root, where its vitality is connected. Since one cherishes and desires that thing, certainly there are souls there connected to one's current portions of nefesh , ruach , and neshamah . Therefore one blesses it first, for the essential completeness and elevation of the souls is through the berachah . However, the Seven Species with which Eretz Yisrael is praised — there is the root of all holy souls. Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of emunah , the root of all souls. Therefore "from there comes forth bread" — all holy eating-abundance comes from there, as Rabbainu writes in the ma'amar "Va'achaltem Achol V'Savo'a" ( Siman 47 ). All foods are the aspect of souls. Therefore the Seven Species have an elevated status and precedence for berachah . This is why our Sages established a specific berachah for fruits — "borai pri ha'adamah" or "borai pri ha'aitz" — not including them in the general "shehakol." For in fruits there are very precious souls, as I understood from Rabbainu's conversation. Therefore they are called pri [fruit] — for the importance of souls depends on da'as ; the nefesh's essential greatness and nourishment is from da'as , as Rabbainu writes. The closer the nefesh is to da'as , the more important. Therefore they are called pri — for da'as is called pri , since it produces fruit. A specific berachah is designated for them due to this importance, mentioning pri in the blessing. Pri ha'aitz is more important than pri ha'adamah — more precious souls are clothed there, in the aspect of "for man is the tree of the field." Therefore if one blessed pri ha'aitz with borai pri ha'adamah , one has fulfilled the obligation — the advantage of adamah applies to them too. But the reverse does not work. And shehakol covers everything: "that everything came into being through His word" — for souls emerge from speech: "my soul departed when He spoke." Various laws in the Shulchan Aruch : some things growing on trees still receive only borai pri ha'adamah — because the specific berachah for tree-fruit was established only due to their importance. When something is not the essential fruit, it lacks that status. Similarly, unripe fruits receive only ha'adamah — the nefesh there is not yet complete, as Rabbainu writes. Therefore one does not bless on the subordinate [ tafel ] at all — only on the main item. Everything follows one's intent and da'as . Since this is the main item for him, it is certainly the completeness of his soul. Therefore one blesses it and exempts the tafel , even if it is bread. For although bread is very important and is the aspect of da'as , since at this moment he does not want bread at all but only the main item — the tafel is exempted. Since the essential completeness and elevation of souls is through da'as , everything follows the person's da'as : if his intent was on certain fruits even though they were not before him, he need not bless again on them — and vice versa. The essential elevation and tikkun depends on the person's da'as . Therefore one must treat foods with honor — where souls are clothed, one must treat them with honor so the souls desire to emerge, for their root is kavod . As Rabbainu writes in the ma'amar "Dirshu" ( Siman 37 ), brought in Hilchos Bais HaKnesses — see there. Halachah 2 — Eretz Yisrael Is Made Through Berachah ; Seven

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 3 Part1
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 3 Part 1 (Introduction + §§ 1–6) COMPLETE · Based on LM I:37 Topic of Birchas HaPairos . Based on the Torah "Dirshu Hashem V'Uzo" ( Siman 37 ) — see the entire Torah there. Summary of the Torah : Body and soul are the aspects of adam and behaima , light and darkness, wisdom and folly, zikaron [memory] and shich'chah [forgetfulness] — the wisdom of Torah versus external wisdoms which are folly compared to Torah wisdom. One must subdue the material — the aspect of death, the folly of the body of the four elements, as stated in the Zohar — through fasting, etc. The reward of fasting is tzedakah . There are two levels of tzedakah : tzedakah in chutz la'Aretz and tzedakah in Eretz Yisrael , which is greater. Similarly two levels of Torah — Torah from breath that has sin versus Torah from breath without sin: "the world endures only through the breath of schoolchildren," etc. Through avira d'Eretz Yisrael [the air of Eretz Yisrael ] and breath without sin, the Avos are revealed in the world to protect, din and darkness are pushed away, the material and folly are subdued, and the intellect — the nefesh , Torah, light, life, and chesed — are elevated. "One who fasts is called a chasid" — "one who benefits his soul is a man of chesed" — for he nullifies din and darkness and draws chasadim , which is gemilas chesed to his nefesh , i.e. to Torah. The root of Torah is the kavod [honor] of Hashem: "for My honor I created it." Therefore through the honor given to the elder who forgot his learning, the nefesh and zikaron are elevated. "Be careful with the jugular veins" — the blood is the nefesh reincarnated for rectification; the shochait must intend to elevate the nefesh in the blood. The essential lack of parnassah comes only through unfit shochtim ; the fit shochait feeds Israel by elevating the souls to the Shechinah . "Be careful with the children of the amai ha'aretz , for from them Torah will go forth" — they are precious souls caught like birds in a snare; through honoring them, Torah is revealed from concealment — for the root of Torah is kavod . § 1 — Birchos HaNehenin Elevate the Nefesh Through Avira d'Eretz Yisrael This is the aspect of birchos hanehenin — it is forbidden to enjoy this world without a berachah . For it is known: through the berachah one recites on a fruit or the like, one elevates the reincarnated nefesh there. For in everything in the world there are reincarnated souls. Therefore the essential berachah is in the aspect of avira d'Eretz Yisrael — so that the food is included in avira d'Eretz Yisrael through the berachah . For "there Hashem commanded the blessing — life" — Eretz Yisrael is the source of all berachos . There all prayers, berachos , and thanks ascend. All birchos hanehenin are derived from Birchas HaMazon : "if he blesses afterward, certainly beforehand." The essence of Birchas HaMazon is in the aspect of Eretz Yisrael : "and you shall eat and be satisfied and bless Hashem your G-d for the good land." All birchos hanehenin are to elevate the nefesh in what one eats. Therefore all birchos hanehenin must be in the aspect of avira d'Eretz Yisrael — "and you shall eat and be satisfied and bless... for the good land" — from which we derive all berachos . To elevate the nefesh through avira d'Eretz Yisrael , which is the breath of schoolchildren without sin. When one blesses on something, "the power of His works" is revealed — one reveals through the berachah that Hashem created the entire world. The essential holiness of Eretz Yisrael is through "the power of His works" — through revealing that Hashem created everything, as Rashi explains on "Beraishis," as Rabbainu writes in many places. It emerges: through the berachah — revealing that Hashem created this thing — that thing is included in the holy air, avira d'Eretz Yisrael , whose essential holiness comes only through "the power of His works." Wherever Israel are, revealing and publicizing holiness — revealing that Hashem created everything — Eretz Yisrael holiness is drawn there, the aspect of mikdash me'at . Through the berachah , the thing is included in avira d'Eretz Yisrael , and through this the nefesh reincarnated there is elevated. For the essential elevation of the nefesh is through avira d'Eretz Yisrael . This is why our Sages cautioned to treat foods with honor — not to disgrace them, as stated in Shulchan Aruch . One must treat foods with honor so the nefesh there is elevated through kavod , which is the root of everything, as explained in the aforementioned ma'amar . It emerges: the essential berachah on everything is in the aspect of avira d'Eretz Yisrael — the breath of schoolchildren. This is why the order of berachos is taught to children at the beginning of their studies — the essential berachah is through the breath of schoolchildren without sin, the aspect of avira d'Eretz Yisrael .

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 3 Part2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 3 Part 2 of 2 (§§ 7–13) — FINAL COMPLETE · Based on LM I:37 § 7 — Shabbos , Wine, and Zikaron This is the aspect of "remember [zachor] the Shabbos day to sanctify it — remember it over wine." Shabbos is the aspect of nefesh — "for on it He rested and was refreshed [va'yinafash]." Then one merits the additional soul, and then the essential revelation of da'as . For Torah was given on Shabbos . The six weekdays are the aspect of body, folly — "the people went out and gathered — in folly," as brought. One must draw the holiness of Shabbos onto the weekdays. The essential nefesh and vitality of the weekdays comes from Shabbos holiness — all six days receive vitality from the additional soul received on Shabbos . Days following Shabbos receive from the previous Shabbos , etc. The verse warns: "remember the Shabbos day — remember it from the first day of the week," as our Sages said. "Remember" specifically — for zikaron is the aspect of nefesh , Torah, da'as — received in the weekdays specifically from Shabbos . By remembering Shabbos from the first day, one nullifies the weekdays (body) in favor of the nefesh ( Shabbos , zikaron ). The essential Shabbos remembrance from the first day is specifically through eating, as our Sages said: "remember it from the first day — like Shammai the Elder who ate all his days in honor of Shabbos." The essential zikaron of Shabbos from the weekdays — memory of the nefesh from within the body — is through eating specifically. This is the essential honor of Shabbos — through Shabbos eating. Through eating, the nefesh is elevated. Therefore it is a great mitzvah to eat on Shabbos — the essential kavod Shabbos . Shabbos is the nefesh and Torah — on Shabbos , the nefesh is elevated through eating. The essential weekday zikaron of Shabbos is through eating — so that eating should be in the aspect of Shabbos , elevating the nefesh and zikaron . This is "remember it over wine" — for wine has two aspects: shich'chah and zikaron . "Lest he drink and forget the statute" — forgetfulness, withdrawal of da'as , sleep. This is when one does not merit. But when one merits, wine is the aspect of zikaron : "we will remember your love more than wine" — "they shall be remembered like the wine of Levanon." This is what our Sages said about wine, called tirosh : "if he merits, he becomes a rosh [head]" — da'as , zikaron , Torah, nefesh . "If he does not merit, he becomes rash [poor]" — "there is no poor but in da'as" — poverty from blemished da'as and nefesh . Therefore on Shabbos , when one transitions from weekdays to Shabbos , from shich'chah to zikaron , one draws Shabbos holiness through wine — "remember it over wine" — "remember" specifically, elevating wine from shich'chah to zikaron . Through this the weekdays are nullified and included in Shabbos holiness. § 8 — Purim: Drinking Wine Subdues Amalek/ Shich'chah This is the intoxication of Purim — the mitzvah to become intoxicated with wine then. For then Haman-Amalek is subdued — the aspect of shich'chah , as brought. Therefore the Torah warns: "remember what Amalek did to you... do not forget" — to subdue shich'chah , the aspect of Amalek, and to elevate the zikaron . Therefore on Purim, the mitzvah is to become intoxicated with wine. For then wine ascends from shich'chah to zikaron . When wine is in holiness — ascending from shich'chah to zikaron — then the essential completeness is specifically through wine. For the essential completeness of zikaron is from within shich'chah , "the advantage of light from darkness." Where there is zikaron and shich'chah — when one merits to overcome and subdue shich'chah (the body) and strengthen zikaron (the nefesh ) — this is the essential completeness. This is wine in holiness. § 9 — Birchas HaMazon Over Wine; Three Berachos = Three Avos This is Birchas HaMazon over wine — so that the eating should be in the aspect of "and you shall remember Hashem your G-d" — meriting zikaron , nefesh , Torah through eating. This is the three berachos of Birchas HaMazon corresponding to the three Avos revealed in the world to protect through avira d'Eretz Yisrael drawn through Birchas HaMazon — by mentioning Eretz Yisrael therein, which is the essence of Birchas HaMazon : "and you shall bless Hashem your G-d for the land." Therefore Torah is mentioned in Birchas HaMazon — the nefesh elevated through eating is the aspect of Torah and zikaron . § 10 — Five Remembrances = Five Levels of the Nefesh This is the aspect of the five remembrances [ chamesh zechiros ]. Zikaron is Torah, the nefesh . Therefore there are five, corresponding to the five levels of the nefesh — the five "bless Hashem, O my soul" — which are the five letters mem-nun-tzadik-pai-chaf [ MaNTzPaCh ], as brought in the ma'amar . Remembrance of Egypt : elevating the nefesh from the exile of Egypt, which encompasses all four exi

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 4 Part1
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 4 Part 1 (§§ 1–5) COMPLETE · Based on LM II:71 Topic of Birchos HaNehenin , precedence in fruits, and the importance of Eretz Yisrael fruits. Based on the Torah "Chavalim Naflu Li Ba'Ne'imim" ( Siman 71, Likutay II ) — see the entire Torah well from beginning to end. § 1 — Birchos HaNehenin : Connecting All Pleasures to No'am Ha'Elyon This is the general aspect of birchos hanehenin . The essential berachah is to elevate the thing and connect it to the No'am Ha'Elyon [Supernal Pleasantness]. It is known that a person should not receive enjoyment and pleasure from the physical thing he eats and drinks, etc., but rather elevate the pleasure and love clothed in it — to elevate it to its supernal root in holiness. The supernal root of all loves and pleasures is the No'am Ha'Elyon , from which all pleasant tastes and pleasures descend and are drawn, in the aspect of "how beautiful and how pleasant — love among delights." All the loves clothed in all pleasures are drawn at their supernal root from the No'am Ha'Elyon — the aspect of Yosef, who was "beautiful of form and beautiful of appearance." For this reason one must bless on everything one wishes to enjoy. Through the berachah , one connects and elevates the thing to its root — to the No'am Ha'Elyon . For all berachos are songs and praises to Hashem — praising and blessing Hashem who created this thing. Therefore all berachos in the world are in the aspect of No'am Ha'Elyon : "for it is pleasant [na'im]; praise is fitting" — "sing to His Name, for it is pleasant [na'im]" — the aspect of "the pleasant singer [ne'im zemiros] of Israel" (Shmuel II, 23), which Rabbainu cites at the end of the aforementioned Torah . All berachos are songs, praises, and glorifications to Hashem, through which the essential connection to the No'am Ha'Elyon is achieved. For it is impossible to cleave to the Creator — to merit the No'am Ha'Elyon , "to gaze upon the pleasantness [no'am] of Hashem" — except through words of berachos , thanks, prayers, songs, and praises, which are all in the aspect of no'am , "ne'im zemiros," etc. This is the general principle of all berachos : one must bless on everything one enjoys — it is forbidden to enjoy this world without a berachah — to elevate and connect all enjoyments, tastes, and pleasures to their root, the No'am Ha'Elyon , which one merits through the berachah with kavanah — the aspect of no'am . Therefore the essential holiness of all foods is from Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of all mitzvos dependent on the Land, all involving types of food, the Seven Species as brought above. For the essential abundance of No'am Ha'Elyon is in Eretz Yisrael , as explained in the Torah . Therefore the essential holiness of eating is there. The essential holiness of eating is when one merits to connect the taste and pleasure to the No'am Ha'Elyon , which is the mochin of Eretz Yisrael . Therefore all berachos on food are derived from Birchas HaMazon : "if he blesses afterward, certainly beforehand." The essential berachah is to draw Eretz Yisrael holiness — the No'am Ha'Elyon . This is why fruits of Eretz Yisrael take precedence — the essential berachah draws Eretz Yisrael holiness, the no'am that is the supernal root of all tastes and pleasures. § 2 — Precedence in Berachos Derives from Kavod and No'am Therefore our Sages established laws of precedence in fruits according to their importance and status. For all kavod and importance in the world is drawn from the No'am Ha'Elyon , as explained — through the abundance of No'am Ha'Elyon , His kavod is revealed, the root of creation, the root of all Ten Utterances. Therefore one must apportion kavod to the fruits for purposes of berachah — giving precedence where due. Through the berachah , the No'am Ha'Elyon is drawn — from which the essential kavod and importance. Therefore most of the honor people give each other involves food and drink — when one enters another's home, one honors him with food or drink. Our Sages said regarding issur v'heter : "a piece fit for honoring." The essential kavod is drawn from No'am Ha'Elyon , clothed in all foods. This is the aspect of a royal table — "the King of kavod." The essential kavod is revealed through the No'am Ha'Elyon received at the holy table when one blesses properly. § 3 — The True Praise of Eretz Yisrael : No'am in Its Fruits This is why the Torah praises Eretz Yisrael with the Seven Species — that it has such good fruits and is "a land flowing with milk and honey." At first glance this is puzzling. Is this the praise of Eretz Yisrael which is so holy? Hashem promised Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov with many promises to give the Land to their descendants, and informed Israel through Moshe many times that He would fulfill His promise. The entire Torah is filled with the praise of Eretz Yisrael — every time He exhorts them to keep Torah

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 4 Part2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 4 Part 2 (§§ 6–11) COMPLETE · Based on LM II:71 § 6 — Pharaoh's " Tichbad Ha'Avodah ": Chovlim Resist the Geulah This is what Pharaoh said: "let the work be heavier." As soon as the sprouting of the horn of salvation awakened — the geulah whose essence is coming to Eretz Yisrael , which is no'am — immediately the chovlim were awakened and fell into the ne'imim . The evil within them surged, inciting Pharaoh to make the labor heavier, to prevent Israel from the geulah , from returning to Eretz Yisrael . From this intensity came Dasan and Aviram, who confronted Moshe and Aharon saying: "may Hashem look upon you and judge" — the aspect of machlokes drawn from the chovlim , awakened by the No'am Ha'Elyon at the onset of geulah . The essential exile of Egypt was drawn from machlokes , the chovlim aspect. The exile was set in motion through the brothers' machlokes with Yosef — who is the aspect of no'am , as explained. The ba'al davar provoked them to quarrel specifically with Yosef. Through this, the chovlim / machlokes prevailed and they descended to Egypt — the exact opposite of Eretz Yisrael / no'am . Egypt is the counterpart of Eretz Yisrael . Therefore they are steeped in immorality — the desire for women derives from blemishing the No'am Ha'Elyon , falling to the love of women. When Yaakov heard the brothers accused as meraglim — hinting at the sin that blemished Eretz Yisrael / no'am (for they too blemished Yosef/ no'am ) — he commanded: "take from the song of the land [mizimras ha'aretz] in your vessels" — fruits of Eretz Yisrael , in which the No'am Ha'Elyon is clothed. To show that Eretz Yisrael is dear to them, and to draw the holiness of No'am Ha'Elyon there, nullifying the chovlim from which all their suffering at Yosef's hands derived. "Mizimras" — the aspect of "ne'im zemiros Yisrael" — the no'am . § 7 — Why Moshe Could Not Enter: Chovlim Overwhelm Even the Greatest From the intensity of the chovlim's resistance at the onset of geulah — making labor heavy, causing machlokes of Dasan and Aviram — they prevailed so greatly that "oppression makes a wise man foolish" — even Moshe said: "why have You done evil?" All from the chovlim's assault. Therefore Hashem told him: "now you will see" — and our Sages said: "'now you will see' — but not what will be done to the thirty-one kings" — hinting he would not enter Eretz Yisrael . Since he could not rectify the chovlim — they even confused his holy mind until he said "why have You done evil" — he certainly could not enter Eretz Yisrael . For upon entering, the chovlim would intensify further, and if he could not rectify them, they would damage Eretz Yisrael's holiness even more. This is why smaller people enter Eretz Yisrael easily while the greatest tzadikim have enormous obstacles. Moshe could not come. Near our generations, the Ba'al Shem Tov and Reb Naftali could not come. For according to Moshe's immense greatness, had he entered, all the chovlim from Adam HaRishon's sin onward would have needed rectification through him. Since the time had not yet come for this — it will not be complete until Mashiach comes and removes the spirit of impurity from the land — they would have caused even greater damage. Therefore Yehoshua, whose level was lesser, entered — the chovlim awakened only proportionally, and this he could rectify through his master Moshe's merit. This is why the commander of Hashem's army came to Yehoshua saying "now I have come" — this is Metatron , comprised of the six orders of Mishnah , where the holy root of the chovlim lies (the machlokes of the Tanna'im and Amora'im who debate — one permits, one forbids). He came to Yehoshua before entering Yericho, the first border of Eretz Yisrael — the chovlim falling into ne'imim for rectification. "You will not be able to destroy them quickly, lest the beasts of the field multiply... little by little I will drive them out until you are fruitful and inherit the land." One must conquer Eretz Yisrael holiness gradually — driving out the evil within the chovlim little by little. We cannot sort the good within them all at once. As the no'am is drawn little by little, the chovlim are rectified accordingly. "Until you are fruitful" — the no'am from which holy birth derives — "and inherit the land" — whose holiness is from No'am Ha'Elyon . This is the struggle every person faces whenever he wants to enter Hashem's service — the more one strives, the more the ba'al davar resists: "whoever is greater than his fellow, his yetzer is greater" (Sukkah 52). The essential holiness of every Jew is drawn from Eretz Yisrael , the No'am Ha'Elyon , the entirety of Torah: "its ways are ways of pleasantness [no'am]." Therefore one must overcome anew each time — to subdue the evil in the chovlim and transform them into no'am , until all mochin are the mochin of Eretz Yisrael . § 8 — Machlokes

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 4 Part3
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 4 Part 3 (§§ 12–16) — FINAL COMPLETE · Based on LM II:71 § 12 — Pharaoh's Dream: Store the Good Years to Survive the Bad "And it was at the end of two years, and Pharaoh dreamed." This happened on Rosh HaShanah — when Yosef left prison. The miracle came through sleep and its awakening — "and Pharaoh awoke" — derived from the root of supernal Malchus built on Rosh HaShanah through sleep and its awakening, as known in the kavanos . Pharaoh's dream — seven years of plenty, seven years of famine. The seven bad years swallowed the good: "it was not known that they came into their belly, and their appearance was as bad as at first." All this alludes to the above. Pharaoh saw the source of Israel's exile. The essential exile is from Eretz Yisrael — where our life and length of days are, where the pleasant mochin flow, the no'am , the essential vitality: "wisdom gives life." Therefore exile was in Egypt — the opposite of Eretz Yisrael / no'am . He saw seven good cows — the seven years of plenty — Eretz Yisrael holiness, source of blessing. All from the Eretz Yisrael mochin / no'am . But immediately after the no'am — "seven other cows came up... evil of appearance... I have not seen their like in all Egypt for ugliness" — the absolute evil, the seven famine years, the evil in the chovlim that destroy everything. Immediately when the no'am flows, the chovlim come for rectification. When the evil grips them too strongly, they overpower the ne'imim and damage even Eretz Yisrael's mochin — the seven good years swallowed and forgotten by the seven bad years. From here the essential Egypt exile and all exiles — all from blemished da'as . Adam ate from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil — machlokes / chovlim — and was expelled from Gan Eden/ Eretz Yisrael . The exile began through selling Yosef/ no'am through machlokes . The exile lengthens because each time a great tzadik draws the No'am Ha'Elyon / Eretz Yisrael mochin , the chovlim come for rectification — and when the time hasn't come, they damage the Eretz Yisrael mochin even more. Egypt's exile first began when Avraham said "how shall I know that I will inherit it" — doubting Eretz Yisrael's inheritance. This is chovlim = machlokes and doubts. As soon as Hashem promised him Eretz Yisrael , the No'am Ha'Elyon was drawn upon him — but the chovlim immediately came and blemished even the Eretz Yisrael mochin he had attained, until doubts fell into his heart. Therefore the decree: "know well [yado'a taida] that your seed will be strangers" — "know well" specifically — for the blemish of da'as , the chovlim / chutz la'Aretz mochin . This is Pharaoh's dream: the seven famine years/ chovlim swallowed the seven good years/ no'am , "unknown that they entered" — the Eretz Yisrael mochin are no longer recognizable, as if they were never drawn. This applies to every person in every era. Sometimes one is aroused toward holiness, the heart aflame with wondrous yearning. It seems certain one will remain devoted. Then an hour later one falls from one's desire, the heart becomes dulled, the mind confused — completely forgetting the first yearning, as if one never had desire for Hashem's service at all. Sometimes the yearning lasts a long time — yet one still falls and forgets everything. All holy inspirations come from the Eretz Yisrael mochin / no'am . When they are drawn, the chovlim immediately come — and if one does not rectify them, they damage the no'am mochin and one forgets everything. Therefore one must guard memory carefully — reminding oneself of all first yearnings, all past enthusiasm and kisufin for Hashem. To retain all the reshimos [impressions] of first yearnings in the depths of one's mind — so one can reawaken through them. As Rabbainu writes: one must hold onto the reshimos from earlier days when His light shone upon him. This is Yosef — the tikkun of Pharaoh's dream. He counseled to preserve the plenty so the land would not be cut off by famine. His counsel: "let them gather all the food of these seven good years, and the food shall be stored" — as soon as any holy good is awakened upon a person, the aspect of Eretz Yisrael holiness from which all holiness derives, one should immediately do some holy deed through one's yearning — pray, learn, do a mitzvah . Make storehouses in one's mind to store all the good of the seven good years. A person has free will and power: when holy desire comes, to store and bind it in the depths of the mind, to take this desire in thought and remember it well — never to forget it. Since Yosef the tzadik informs in advance that evil days will come, wanting to make one forget all that good — the wise person understands to store well all the good of the seven good years: to bind the holy desire in thought, and determine that even when the heart becomes dulled by the chovlim's evil, one will strengthen one

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 5 Part1
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 5 Part 1 (Intro + §§ 1–5) COMPLETE · Based on LM II:88 Topic of Birchas HaPairos and the precedence of Eretz Yisrael fruits. Based on Likutay II, Siman 88 : there are lost things [ avaidos ]. See the preceding Siman: kavanos of Elul = tikkun habris , finding one's match, the secret Avraham transmitted to Eliezer. One must be careful not to eat a fruit before it has ripened, for one can lose one's nefesh . Even so, if one recites the berachah on the fruit with kavanah and yiras Shamayim , one can be saved from this. And if one is even stronger, one can find avaidos [lost things] there. See there regarding the malachim — they all hold shofros in their hands and they stand, digging and searching constantly for avaidos . They sound teru'ah , and when they find some avaidah , a great commotion and joy ensues. For there are many lost things — what is lost through desires: "the desire of the wicked shall perish." He said all the above — the kavanos of Elul, the fruits, the malachim — are all one matter, containing awesome, deeply hidden secrets. § 1 — Searching for Avaidos : The Essence of Man's Purpose The Torah explains well the topic of birchas hapairos — how much one must be careful to bless on fruits with great kavanah , to find the hidden avaidos within them. Even when the fruit is fully ripe, there are still many holy sparks — avaidos — that one must search for carefully. This is the entirety of man: he was created to search for avaidos — the fallen sparks, the lost and banished — which every person must strive to seek all his life. Especially if he has sinned and blemished, particularly pgam habris , through which he himself lost many more avaidos . Each person must have compassion on his own life and search for these avaidos . If he searches well, he will certainly find: "I toiled and did not find — do not believe." This is the essential teshuvah : "and you shall return to Hashem your G-d... if your banished ones are at the ends of the heavens, from there Hashem your G-d will gather you, and from there He will take you." And: "you shall seek Hashem your G-d from there, and find Him when you seek with all your heart and soul." And: "if you seek it like silver, like hidden treasures... then you will understand the fear of Hashem." One must search greatly for the ways of holiness. Whatever distance a person is from Hashem comes from these avaidos — through them he wanders like a lost sheep, unable to find the path of life: "I have strayed like a lost sheep" — "I was like a lost vessel... they sought to take my soul." This is Rosh HaShanah — the first day of teshuvah , the first of the ten days. We blow shofar — is'arusa dil'sata awakens above. Through our blowing, we empower and give strength to the malachim holding shofros , that they should strive harder to search for the avaidos . This is the essence of teshuvah — the tikkun for all sins caused by desires, through which one loses what one loses, Rachmana litzlan : "the desire of the wicked shall perish." The wicked who never repent: "let the wicked perish" — "the way of the wicked shall perish." But Hashem had mercy and gave us holy Rosh HaShanah and commanded the shofar — through which the essential searching for avaidos lost through desires is accomplished. Therefore in Birchos Shofros specifically we pray for gathering the banished: "sound the great shofar for our freedom, raise a banner to gather our exiles." Daily in Shemoneh Esrai we begin the prayer for gathering the banished with "Sound the shofar" — for the essential gathering of the banished/ avaidos is through the shofar . Therefore one must travel to tzadikim for Rosh HaShanah specifically. All the avaidos are with the tzadikim , who already searched extensively until they found them all — even the avaidos of the entire world (as in LM I:188 ). On Rosh HaShanah , when the shofar sounds and teshuvah begins, one must come to great, true tzadikim where all the avaidos are. We read the birth of Yitzchak on Rosh HaShanah , and on the second day conclude with the finding of his match: "and Besuel fathered Rivkah." For the entire matter of Rosh HaShanah is in the aspect of Pachad Yitzchak — gevuros . Due to the severity of gevuros and dinim , the avaidos are hard to find — they were lost through the dinim gripping them through sins. This is the entirety of the exiles, called "lost": "you will surely be lost." On Rosh HaShanah , Pachad Yitzchak , we sweeten this — sweetening the gevuros of Yitzchak through Israel's prayer, primarily through the shofar . The essential sweetening is completed on the second day ( dina rafya ), when the Torah reading concludes with the finding of Yitzchak's match — the essential sweetening. For Yitzchak's match was extremely difficult to find, and Avraham had to transmit the secret — the secret of Elul's kavanos — to Eliezer. Each year on Ros

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 5 Part2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 5 Part 2 (§§ 6–10) COMPLETE · Based on LM II:88 and LM I:6 § 6 — Kavanos of Elul: Teshuvah , Shame, and the Path of Return The essential finding of the avaidos is through the kavanos of Elul — through which one merits to find one's match in holiness. The kavanos of Elul are the Torah "Kera es Yehoshua" ( LM I:6 ). The essence of that Torah : one must do teshuvah , and thereby merit kavod Eloki [G-dly honor]. The essence of teshuvah is when one hears his humiliation and is silent — enduring shame and bloodshed to subdue the blood in the left chamber of the heart, source of all desires and all sins, Rachmana litzlan . The essence of teshuvah is Ehekeh — ana zamin l'mehevai [I am prepared to come into being]. When one wishes to repent, he begins to prepare himself to have existence in the world, for before teshuvah he has no existence at all — it would have been better for him not to have been created. When he wishes to repent, he begins to prepare himself to have existence — this is Ehekeh . But before teshuvah he is in the aspect of achorai p'nai Ehekeh , which is the gematria of dam [blood]. The tikkun : to transform dam to dom [silence] — to be among those who hear their disgrace and do not respond, not insisting on the honor of his kavod . One must always hold to the quality of teshuvah . Even if one has done complete teshuvah , one must still do teshuvah upon teshuvah — repenting over one's first level of attainment. When a person wishes to walk in the ways of teshuvah , he must be baki b'halachah [expert in the law]. He needs two expertises: baki birtzo [expert in running forward] and baki bishuv [expert in returning] — as it says: "Fortunate is one who enters and exits." This is: "if I ascend to the heavens, You are there" — entering, baki birtzo ; "if I make my bed in the depths, behold You" — exiting, baki bishuv . This is the secret of the kavanos of Elul. Through this, one becomes adam [a true human] — to sit upon the Throne. For there is no adam without the Alef : the lower point, the upper point, and the Vav within the Alef . See all of this there well. This is the Exodus from Egypt. The Exodus is teshuvah — the aspect of Binah , from which all aspects of the Exodus derive: the mochin that were hidden and concealed through sins (source of all exiles) now emerge and are born and revealed. One begins to know and recognize the One Who spoke and the world came into being. Then Ehekeh is revealed: "Ehekeh has sent me to you." But in exile it was achorai p'nai Ehekeh = gematria dam — source of all exile: "I passed over you and saw you wallowing in your blood." As explained in the kavanos of Pesach: the essential exile was through the dominance of the blood that grips from achorai p'nai Ehekeh as long as one hasn't merited teshuvah . The essence of teshuvah is to merit entering and exiting — baki birtzo baki bishuv , "if I ascend to the heavens... if I make my bed in the depths" — that whatever happens, one holds firm and never lets oneself fall. Even in the lowest depths one finds Him: "if I make my bed in the depths, behold You." But at the time of the Exodus, Israel had not yet been fully purified and left before the appointed time, as brought. "Leaping over the mountains" — He leaped over the kaitz [appointed end]. Therefore it is called Pesach — He skipped and leaped and redeemed them in His mercy even though they were not yet worthy. Therefore they had to leave in haste. For this reason we must eat matzah — the aspect of haste. They had not yet merited the ways of teshuvah in completeness, for they were not yet expert in halachah ; they had not yet received the Torah. The entire geulah was in the aspect of ratzo [running forward] — an arousal from Above, a great supernal light that shone upon them in His mercy, but only temporarily, as brought. Afterward, that intense illumination withdrew, and they needed to return and purify themselves from Egypt's contamination gradually — this is shuv , exiting . Then is the essential test for a person. So it is with every person: initially, when one wishes to draw close to Hashem, a great light shines from Above — he begins to pray with vitality and enthusiasm. But then he falls from this, and passes through what he passes through — shuv , exiting . Then he must strengthen himself immeasurably, being well-expert in this, never leaving his place — baki b'halachah . Because at the time of the Exodus they had not yet merited these expertises in completeness, and the geulah was only ratzo — haste — they must eat matzah baked in haste. Then they begin counting the days of the Omer , returning to purify themselves from Egypt's contamination gradually. They begin to draw the aspect of baki bishuv . This is the essence of Krias Yam Suf — the tikkun of the smallest mochin , as explained in the kavanos . The Egyptians pursued from behind,

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 5 Part3
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 5 Part 3 (§§ 11–15) COMPLETE · Based on LM I:6 and LM II:88 § 11 — Sefiras Ha'Omer : The Tzadik , Humiliation, and Teshuvah upon Teshuvah This is Sefiras Ha'Omer . The essential mitzvah of Sefirah is to prepare for receiving the Torah on Shavuos through Moshe Rabbainu. This occurs in every generation through the true tzadik , the aspect of Moshe, through whom is the essential tikkun of every person. Whoever wishes to have compassion on himself must strive with all his strength to draw close to him in truth. I heard from Rabbainu zichrono livrachah after he taught the Torah "Kera es Yehoshua" : wherever there is a true Rav and a student, it is the aspect of Moshe, Yehoshua, and the Ohel Mo'aid — the upper point upon the Alef , the lower point, and the Vav within the Alef . Through this, adam is formed. See there: through silence, the lower point is formed — "the earth is My footstool." The upper point is Keser — teshuvah , merited through silence. The Vav is the firmament — fire and water, the aspect of shame whose face changes to many colors. Through this, adam is made — Alef-dam . Then a unification occurs between sun and moon — the sun illuminates the moon — Moshe and Yehoshua. Moshe is the upper point; Yehoshua is the lower. The Vav is the Tent: "Yehoshua bin Nun, a youth, did not depart from within the Tent." Therefore one must endure humiliations and bloodshed before drawing close to the true tzadik — and even after, one must endure bloodshed each time anew. All is for tremendous good — the essence of his teshuvah . Through this specifically he merits standing firm, not distancing from Hashem or the tzadik despite everything. According to this Torah , it is all one aspect: the essence of teshuvah through hearing one's disgrace and being silent, enduring bloodshed — through which adam is formed. This is also drawing close to the tzadik /Moshe (upper point); the student (lower point). Only merited through bloodshed and humiliation. When one endures these to draw close to the tzadik , this is his essential teshuvah — to become adam . The essential thing: the upper point illuminates the lower through the Vav — the bloodshed and humiliations. This is itself the tzadik 's illumination (upper point) into the student (lower point). All one aspect. One must endure much when drawing close to the true tzadik , for teshuvah is only through the true tzadik , the aspect of Moshe: baki b'halachah — baki birtzo baki bishuv , baki b'ayil baki b'nafik : "if I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in the depths, behold You." This is also the upper and lower points, as in the Elul kavanos . To remain steadfast in holy Jewishness, one must endure humiliations and bloodshed anew each time — for one needs teshuvah upon teshuvah in many aspects. For most people, the first teshuvah was not complete — even saying "I have sinned," one cannot say it without some p'niyah [ulterior motive]. One certainly needs many rounds of teshuvah upon teshuvah until meriting complete teshuvah and viduy without any p'niyah . Everyone can understand this is impossible in one or two attempts — fortunate is he who truly merits it after many years. Even one who achieves complete teshuvah still needs teshuvah upon teshuvah — repenting over his first level of attainment. The true tzadik merited this in the ultimate completeness beyond which there is none. Even at the ultimate completeness of teshuvah , he still does teshuvah upon teshuvah . Even at an exceedingly exalted level that seems the highest possible, he says: "Who knows what more there is — for His greatness is unfathomable." As I heard from him zichrono livrachah , and as explained in Chayai Moharan in several places. Whoever holds to this tzadik will certainly have a truly good and eternal end, even if he passes through whatever he passes through. Just as one must be baki birtzo , so too baki bishuv : "if I make my bed in the depths, behold You." Just as the true tzadik is never satisfied — even at the pinnacle of a truly exceedingly exalted level, saying "who knows what more" and striving for teshuvah upon teshuvah ever further — so too a person must know the reverse: even if it seems he is at the lowest level, with nothing beneath him, he must still strive: perhaps there is still hope. For in truth there is no despair in the world at all — as Rabbainu zichrono livrachah cried out many times. "Waters flowed over my head; I said 'I am cut off.' I called Your Name, Hashem, from the lowest pit." See Rashi there. This is baki birtzo baki bishuv . But all this can only be merited through the true tzadik who already merited this in completeness — doing teshuvah upon complete teshuvah always. He is at the ultimate pinnacle of the upper point, able to illuminate true hischazkus into the very lowest point. One must know: just as there is no limit going

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 5 Part4
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 5 Part 4 (§§ 16–19) COMPLETE · Based on LM I:6 § 16 — Four Halachos Hidden from Moshe: The Alef , the Three Mitzvos , and Why Moshe Could Not Enter This is the four halachos that were hidden from Moshe Rabbainu, which he had to ask from Hashem: the law of the blasphemer, the law of the mekoshaish [Shabbos-violator], the law of Pesach Shaini , and the law of Bnos Tzelafchad — as in Targum Yonasan and Yerushalmi on the verse "they placed him in custody, to clarify for them" : one of the four laws, etc. As explained at the end of this Torah : the entire matter is comprised in the shape of the Alef — upper point, lower point, and Vav . This is the three mitzvos commanded upon entering Eretz Yisrael : to cut off the seed of Amalek, appoint a king, and build the Bais HaMikdash — which are the lower point, upper point, and Vav . In our great sins, we did not merit that Moshe enter Eretz Yisrael and fulfill these three mitzvos himself — which would have rectified everything. These three mitzvos are the lower and upper points etc. — baki b'halachah : baki birtzo baki bishuv , baki b'ayil b'nafik , "if I ascend to the heavens... if I make my bed in the depths" — the essential paths of teshuvah . Had Moshe entered and fulfilled these, he would have drawn baki b'halachah and rectified all Israel forever. But through the sin of the Golden Calf and the spies, Moshe was prevented from entering. Without this, they did not merit baki b'halachah in completeness. Even though Moshe drew these ways of teshuvah into the world — "if I ascend to the heavens... if I make my bed in the depths" , the kavanos of Elul — during the final forty days of favor from Elul through Yom Kippur , establishing Elul and the ten days of teshuvah forever, granting forgiveness on Yom Kippur — nonetheless we did not receive this expertise in completeness. Each person according to his distance from this expertise is distant from teshuvah . Through this we were exiled from our Land; the Bais HaMikdash (the upper point) was destroyed; we have no king (the Vav ); and we cannot cut off Amalek's seed — the Sitra Achra and all enemies physical and spiritual (the tikkun of the lower point). All because Moshe did not enter Eretz Yisrael , where the essential completeness of baki b'halachah lies: "when a matter is too wondrous... you shall rise and ascend to the Place." Therefore four halachos were hidden from Moshe. The law of the blasphemer: the aspect of cutting off Amalek's seed — the blasphemer who reviled and cursed, like Amalek. Moshe did not know what to do with him, for the essential work of Moshe and all true tzadikim in his aspect is to connect the very lowest point to the upper — to illuminate even the lowest, pray for them, have mercy on them, draw them close. For this they endure humiliation and bloodshed, all to draw everyone close — as we saw how Moshe risked his soul after the Golden Calf, praying for Israel, saving them from destruction: "were it not for Moshe His chosen who stood in the breach." Therefore Moshe was uncertain what to do with the blasphemer — perhaps patience should be extended to him too. Especially since this was the son of an Egyptian whom Moshe had killed prematurely, for which he himself was obligated in exile, as brought on: "then Moshe separated three cities." Therefore he was uncertain now, until Hashem told him: he is liable to sekilah [stoning]. For even though one must be silent about one's own disgrace, regarding Hashem's disgrace — one who blasphemes and reviles — one must exact retribution in every way possible. About this it says: "these things you did and I was silent; you thought I would be just like you — I will reprove you and set it before your eyes" — brought in this Torah . The law of the mekoshaish who blemished Shabbos: the aspect of blemishing the upper point — teshuvah , the aspect of Shabbos. Shabbos is Keser , kavod Elokim hasair davar [the honor of G-d is to conceal a matter], Torah secrets, Oraisa d'Atika s'sima'ah — all the upper point, the concealed Throne. The law of Pesach Shaini : the aspect of shame and bloodshed one must endure to connect the lower to the upper — the Vav within the Alef , the aspect of heaven. For those people who were impure and could not make the Pesach — they came and asked: "why should we be diminished?" They asked properly and rectified greatly, for through them a great merit was set in motion: the law of Pesach Shaini was revealed to Moshe — a great tikkun , drawing the path of teshuvah . This is the essential completeness of teshuvah : even when one sees himself far from Hashem, impure from his evil deeds — he should strengthen himself, come in submission before the true tzadik and before Hashem, and ask about his soul. Just as those impure people asked: "why should we be diminished from offering Hashem's offering?" So too each person sho

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Birchas HaPairos 5 Part5
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Birchas Hapairos Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Birchas HaPairos — Halachah 5 Part 5 (§§ 20–23) COMPLETE · Based on LM I:6 and LM II:88 § 20 — The Census: Counting = Guarding Against Avaidos ; Sh'kalim and Korbanos Hashem commanded counting Israel, each one called "going forth to the army." Each person must be among those going forth to the army — "yotzai tzava" specifically: when one is in the aspect of nafik [exiting], one must be a m'lumad milchamah [trained warrior]. This is the counting commanded after the Golden Calf — as Rashi explains: when they sinned, He counted them. All these — the Mishkan 's construction, the camp of the banners, and the counting — were all commanded after the Golden Calf. Moshe exerted himself greatly during the final forty days, drawing the path of teshuvah into the world: from Elul through Yom Kippur — the secret of Elul's kavanos , tikkun habris , "Who makes a way in the sea," the path of teshuvah : baki twice = derech . After drawing this path, Hashem commanded the Mishkan , the counting, and the camp of the banners — all aspects of the teshuvah path. The essential thing is drawn through the Mishkan / Ohel Mo'aid : through it, Moshe's aspect illuminates Yehoshua — the upper into the lower point — drawing baki b'halachah . The upper point illuminates even the very lowest — all becoming m'lumdai milchamah , strengthening until all are among the "sixty mighty men" around the Mishkan — the 600,000 souls of Israel = 600,000 letters of the Torah. Therefore the counting was commanded. At first glance: the Torah explains that counting is dangerous — "there shall be no plague among the Children of Israel when you count them." The sh'kalim were needed as remedy. Why count at all? In truth, Israel are above counting: "if a man can count [the dust]... so shall your seed be counted."
