The tikun through the Mishkan built by Moshe through Betzalel and Ahali'av — drawing the revelation of His G-dliness and Malchus : "who is this ascending?" [The essential tikun of the contraction is through speech — the speech of prayer, songs, and praises = the three daily prayers.] § 18 — The Early Chasidim : Silent Preparation, Then Prayer in Speech "The early chasidim would wait an hour and then pray." First they would cling to the Ohr Ain Sof in wondrous d'vaikus (= the silent hour before prayer). Then, seeing they might ascend beyond measure, chas v'shalom , they contracted the Ohr Ain Sof in their hearts and engaged in prayer through speech — the essential tikun of the contraction: "who is this ascending?" = "service of the heart — this is prayer" = the essential revelation of His Malchus . Afterward they would wait another hour — elevating Malchus ( baisa tata'ah ) together with baisa ila'ah : "who is this ascending from the wilderness?" — specifically through the speech of prayer. Only after Malchus is revealed does baisa ila'ah ascend. "My heart was hot within me; in my meditation fire burned" — nearly consumed by excessive enthusiasm (= the flaw of Nadav and Avihu: "when they drew near before Hashem" ). The tikun: "I spoke with my tongue" = the speech of prayer. § 19 — Purim and the War Against Haman-Amalek: Every Good Point Matters Purim and the war against Haman-Amalek. The tzadik 's entire work: to reveal His Malchus to all — from the highest to the lowest levels — extracting even souls that fell into the deepest places. Through the above tikun: contracting the light, overpowering bad thoughts, revealing Malchus . Even one who damaged terribly (falling into bad thoughts that are among the "twenty-four things obstructing teshuvah ") — Hashem will illuminate him wondrously, strengthening him each time against bad thoughts. He should not despair from any thoughts that pass over him — knowing that every point and movement of detaching from bad to good is exceedingly precious to Hashem. Haman-Amalek (encompassing all klipos ) is the opposite of all this — intent on evil from beginning to end. Drawing from the dregs of the Breaking of Vessels (= the kings of Edom who died; Haman's ten sons = the ten impure crowns). Amalek overpowers in bad thoughts: "every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil all the day" — the final letters spell Amalek . "The first of the nations is Amalek, and his end is destruction" — his very overpowering causes his destruction. The moment a person begins detaching thought from evil to good, Amalek confuses him — the tzadik 's war is fought for the weak of Israel. "Remember what Amalek did to you... he attacked the stragglers" — cooling the weak. Only through the great tzadikim (Moshe, Yehoshua, master and students) can he be subdued — not all at once (Hashem desires the world's continuance, wanting all sparks clarified through is'arusa d'l'sata ). The essential: instilling in them the skill of "expert in running forth, expert in returning" — contracting enthusiasm, valuing every movement

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Tefilas HaMinchah Halachah 7 Part3
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Tefilas Haminchah Halachah Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Tefilas HaMinchah [Laws of the Afternoon Prayer] Halachah 7, Part 3 (§§ 32–55) Based on LM I:49 ( LaShemesh Ohel Bahem ), continued § 32 — Comforting Mourners; Death and Resurrection; the Tzadik Who Gathers Good Points Comforting mourners [ nichum availim ]: the essential consolation is the consolation of Tziyon and Yerushalayim ( "May the Omnipresent console you among the mourners of Tziyon and Yerushalayim" ). The principle: since the light (= the soul) already existed in the world and was then withdrawn and died — there is hope to repair it (= techiyas hamasim ). Death derives from the death of the Melachim [kings] at Creation's beginning through excessive light. Yet the worlds could not have come into existence otherwise. The difficulty in revealing His light was only due to its excess — no world can endure Ain Sof . Hashem desired His light to shine specifically in Olam HaAsiyah (= free will). Therefore He contracted through many contractions — all through ratzo v'shov (drawing, concealing, drawing again, many times), until creating the world. But all depends on man's is'arusa d'l'sata . Adam sinned immediately; Hashem worked on his tikun — he returned in teshuvah (our Sages). Since then, death was decreed. But now death is a great good: "behold, it was very good — this is death." Due to Adam's and the generations' corruption, one cannot receive the needed light while alive. One must die — then be purified and arise at techiyas hamasim with a wondrous new light. Since the light already existed and departed, it can be renewed — vessels purified to receive greater light (just as at Creation: through light appearing and withdrawing, vessels formed; = the death of the Melachim and their tikun — precisely through shattering, the new Ohr Ma"H emerged). All depends on teshuvah : every arousal to return — however small — is never lost ( "no good will is ever lost" [Zohar]). Through teshuvah , sins become merits — vessels are thickened, then purified into wondrous new vessels for greater light. "Descent for the purpose of ascent; sins transformed to merits; distance for the purpose of closeness." Not everyone merits this on his own — only through the great tzadikim who know this secret deeply. They awaken people to teshuvah , gather every tiny good point and arousal, building wondrous tikun from them. Whoever desires life must seek the tzadik who can work on his tikun — the very searching is an immense good. Hashem and the true tzadikim work constantly on Israel's souls — but need some is'arusa d'l'sata . "Open for Me as a needle's eye, and I shall open for you..." The essential: do not mock or oppose those who work on your tikun. "Return to Hashem your G-d... from all the places where He has driven you... even if your dispersed are at the ends of the heavens, from there Hashem will gather you... and Hashem will circumcise your heart." = "You return man to dakah [being crushed]" — even from the crushing of soul. The tzadikim can transform all descents to ascents, all sins to merits. This is our consolation for the Bais HaMikdash's destruction: since the light already existed (though destroyed twice), a reshimu remains — through this, the third Bais HaMikdash will be built in even greater tikun: "the glory of this latter house shall be greater." Like an artisan who breaks and remakes his vessel many times until perfected — "all these G-d does, two and three times with a man." = building worlds and destroying them (= Breaking of Vessels and tikun). One must know: as long as any arousal exists, there is always hope through the tzadikim . Nullify one's own wisdom entirely before them: "whoever is small is great." § 33 — Matzah : the Letter Hai ; Bread of Poverty The difference between chametz and matzah is in the letter Hai : "between chametz and matzah there is only a mashehu [hairsbreadth]" — the tiny space of the Hai 's hollow. All = tikun of the contractions. The Hai was a Dales (poor and destitute, without knowledge) and was restored to Hai . Matzah = lechem oni [bread of poverty] — its holiness is in the Hai (called "poor" because the Dales was poor). The essential tikun is teshuvah : when bad thoughts overpower (= foolishness of heart = the essential poverty: "there is no poor man except in da'as " ) = Dales . When one overpowers and sanctifies thought → Hai . Matzah = holy thoughts (opposite chimutz hamoach [fermenting of the brain] with bad thoughts). "This is the bread of poverty" ; "broken matzah — as is the poor man's way." The essential tikun: emerging from poverty/lack of da'as to sanctified da'as = is'arusa d'l'sata . Then His Malchus is revealed in completeness — both houses ascend. = Hai was a Dales and was restored to Hai . § 34 — Kiddush HaChodesh : "Bring an Atonement for Me" — Only Man Below Can Repair The moon's blemish and Kiddush HaChodesh (§26). When the moon was not appeased, H

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Tefilas HaMinchah Halachah 7 Part4
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Tefilas Haminchah Halachah Part Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Tefilas HaMinchah [Laws of the Afternoon Prayer] Halachah 7, Part 4 (§§ 56–81) Based on LM I:49 ( LaShemesh Ohel Bahem ), continued and concluded § 56 — R' Shimon bar Yochai: the Zohar as Tikun of the Contractions; Lag BaOmer The essential tikun through R' Shimon bar Yochai and his companions, who said: "there [among the previous students] fear was fitting; here we exist through love." R' Shimon engaged especially in repairing the contractions — tikun of vessels to draw the Ohr Ain Sof and reveal His G-dliness. The entire Zohar HaKadosh — especially the Idra Rabba and Idra Zuta — drew and repaired wondrous contractions (= metzach , aynin , tikunai dikna kadisha [forehead, eyes, tikun of the holy beard]) — all awesome contractions through which the Ohr Ain Sof is perceived. Therefore he said: "through this [the Zohar] they will leave exile" — through tikun of the contractions = essential tikun of teshuvah = redemption ( "the matter depends only on teshuvah " [Zohar]). He guaranteed: the Torah will not be forgotten from Israel — "it shall not be forgotten from the mouth of his seed." R' Shimon departed on Lag BaOmer. In Eretz Yisrael, great joy is made at his hilula — seemingly one should mourn! But minhag Yisrael Torah [the custom of Israel is Torah]: the joy is that such a tzadik existed, who revealed such awesome Torah and made such tikun — through which the Torah will never be forgotten. He completed this specifically through his departure (repairing the flaw of R' Akiva's students who died prematurely). He revealed the Idra Zuta at his departure — besides the Idra Rabba, Sifra d'Tzniusa, and the entire Zohar in his lifetime. Through all this: in every generation, whoever wishes to return can draw close from any place, through the tikun of the contractions he made in his life and especially on his holy day of departure ( "the tzadikim are greater in death than in life" ). Now, the Torah's sustenance and our entire hope is through the great departed tzadikim ( "were it not for the prayers of the dead tzadikim for the living, the world would not endure a single moment" [Zohar]). R' Shimon and his companions were the tikun of R' Akiva's students who died (= death of the Melachim = Breaking of Vessels). Through the departed students' souls, wondrous tikun was made — since their lights already existed and were withdrawn, a reshimu remained, enabling even greater tikun (= tikun of the Breaking). [See the Idra Rabba (135a): "were they abolished? Rather, they were withdrawn from that tikun until the tikun of Adam came, and then all were restored." ] Four entered the Pardes : [Ben Azzai] did not contract the light → gazed and was stricken (= damaged the song simple). [Ben Zoma] tried to contract but saw the tremendous turmoil of yetzirah l'vish and was terrified → gazed and died (= damaged the song double). [Acher] entered the battle of the inclinations and did not withstand → cut the saplings (= damaged the song triple) — "Greek song never ceased from his mouth" ; when he left the study hall, heretical books fell — he fell into external wisdoms through not nullifying his pride before the true tzadikim . R' Akiva entered in peace and departed in peace — facing tremendous tests (the wife of Turnus Rufus, etc.) — he wept, laughed, and spat. His soul departed with the Dales of "Echad" — where the entirety of song simple/double/triple/quadruple is encompassed. He merited that all tikun should be through him. But his students flawed through machaloikes — dying between Pesach and Shavuos. The tikun began through R' Shimon bar Yochai. § 57 — The Splitting of the Sea: Mochin d'Katnus ; Tefilah l'Ani Reaches Even There The splitting of the Yam Suf : the Ari"zal explains it is the secret of mochin d'katnus [extremely constricted consciousness] that can only be sweetened through Atika : "why do you cry to Me? The matter depends on Atika ." Through what was explained above (§§40-41): one can understand wondrous hints for strengthening in prayer from any place — even from the most extreme katnus (alluded to in the danger at the sea [the Ari"zal's kavanos regarding the serpent]). Still — "there is no despair in the world" : there is hope through Atika — from the secret of Minchas HaOmer of barley = the asiris ha'aifah not revealed to Avraham. One must hold on [ der haltin zich ] even there — through a part from among millions and myriads that one still has (= the poor man's offering that can come in halves and portions). Prayer even in this state can save — such prayer is exceedingly precious ( tefilah l'ani , the asiris ha'aifah ). The secret of how far His mercy extends = "why do you cry to Me? — the matter depends on Atika " = Ra'ava d'Ra'avin where Yosef/Moshe/David departed (§46). "Your wife is short — bend down and whisper to her" (= prayer). When Malchus is in katnus (= the lesser luminary), one must raise it

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Tefilas HaMinchah Halachos 1-2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 2 - Tefilas Haminchah Halachos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Volume 2 Hilchos Tefilas HaMinchah [Laws of the Afternoon Prayer] Halachos 1–2 Halachah 1 — Minchah Is the Awakening from the Sleep of Commerce Based on LM I:35 ( Ashrai HaAm ) Halachah : A person should not sit before the barber close to Minchah time, etc. The Shulchan Aruch discusses the opinions that specifically close to Minchah the Sages decreed [not to begin certain activities]; see there. It appears to my humble understanding that Tefilas HaMinchah is the aspect of the awakening from sleep. Throughout the day, a person is occupied with his affairs, his commerce [ masa u'matan ]. Commerce is the aspect of sleep — therefore Tefilas HaMinchah was established to remind man to remember Hashem and awaken from his sleep (= from the commerce, which is the aspect of sleep). Therefore Tefilas HaMinchah is the aspect of Rosh HaShanah — the awakening from the sleep that is commerce. As Rabbainu zichrono livrachah writes all this in the teaching " Ashrai HaAm " ( LM I:35 ); see there. Yitzchak established Tefilas HaMinchah , and Rosh HaShanah is Pachad Yitzchak [the Fear of Yitzchak]. Therefore the prayer is called by the name Minchah — a Minchah being the offering of the poor man, the aspect of dinim [judgments], for then judgments prevail — the aspect of Rosh HaShanah , the aspect of Pachad Yitzchak . This is what our Sages say: "one should always be careful with Tefilas HaMinchah , for Eliyahu was answered only at Minchah time." Eliyahu's request and prayer was to reveal emunah in the world — to know that "Hashem, He is G-d" (as explained there). He was answered only at Minchah time — because Minchah is beneficial for emunah , based on what is explained: Minchah is the awakening from sleep. Through this, emunah is renewed, as Rabbainu writes: during commerce the soul enters into emunah (= commerce in emunah ) and is renewed there. Afterward, when one awakens from sleep, the mind is renewed with additional emunah . Minchah (= the awakening from sleep) — through this one merits emunah . Therefore Eliyahu merited then to reveal emunah in the world: "Hashem, He is G-d." Since emunah is in the aspect of "this is Yerushalayim — in the midst of the nations I have placed her" and the chitzonim [external forces] draw sustenance from her — one must be very careful. One needs caution and exertion not to remain submerged there, chas v'shalom — not to let them overpower, since they draw sustenance from there. This is: "one should always be careful with Tefilas HaMinchah " — then extra caution is needed. Therefore the Sages decreed that specifically close to Minchah one should not begin any work or eating — lest he forget to pray. Specifically then they were concerned, since then judgments prevail — the chitzonim drawing from emunah . Therefore they decreed these decrees — lest he forget, for then extra caution is needed lest they overpower him. Halachah 2 — Minchah , Charity, and the Revelation of the Will Based on LM II:4 ( Uvyom HaBikurim / Rav Yehudah HaNadvoah) Based on the teaching " Uvyom HaBikurim — of Rav Yehudah HaNadvoah"; LM II:4 . See the entire teaching there well. The summary that emerges: through tzedakah one repairs the flaw of the elders of the generation who are not as they should be. Then the metzach hanachash [forehead of the serpent] (= the root of natural wisdom, which draws its sustenance from there) is subdued. Then the voice of the call of Yom Tov is heard — the revelation of the Will — through connecting to the root of Will, the metzach haratzon [forehead of Will] (= the aspect of the passing of Moshe, etc.). The voice of the roaring of the evil creatures (= the wise men of nature, etc.) is subdued. See there well. Through the revelation of the Will, awe is achieved; through awe, chesed flows — and then one need not engage in any work or commerce: the world is sustained through His chesed , and "strangers shall stand and tend your flocks." § 1 — Prayer Is the Revelation of the Will; Evil Thoughts Come from Evil Creatures This is the aspect of tefilah . Tefilah is the revelation of the Will — through prayer to Hashem, it is revealed that everything is by His will. Natural wisdom is subdued, for tefilah changes nature (nature dictates one thing, but tefilah changes it — as explained in Rabbainu's words many times). Tefilah is the revelation of the Will — the aspect of Yom Tov . Therefore three daily tefilos were established corresponding to the three Regalim [Festivals] (which are the revelation of the Will), and also corresponding to the three Avos: Avraham established Shacharis , Yitzchak established Minchah , etc. The three tefilos are in the aspect of the three Regalim — the revelation of the Will. Therefore the essential tefilah is when there is an ais ratzon [a time of favor]: "as for me, my prayer is to You, Hashem — at a time of favor." An ais ratzon is the revelation of the metzach haratzon — then te

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - ArbaParshiyos
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Arbaparshiyos LIKUTAY HALACHOS — ORACH CHAIM, PART III The Matter of the Four Parshiyos Inyan Arba Parshiyos Note on terminology: Bechina (pl. bechinos ) is a key term in Reb Nachman's teachings, retained here untranslated. It denotes a dimension, mode, or spiritual register. The construct form bechinas already means "the bechina of" — e.g. bechinas Eretz Yisrael = the Eretz Yisrael- bechina . Background — The Four Parshiyos: During the month of Adar, on four consecutive Shabbosos, an additional Torah portion ( maftir ) is read from a second Sefer Torah. They are: Parshas Shekalim — the half-shekel donation commanded for the Mishkan (Shemos 30:11–16) Parshas Zachor — the commandment to remember and blot out Amalek (Devarim 25:17–19), read on the Shabbos before Purim Parshas Parah — the Red Heifer purification rite (Bamidbar 19:1–22) Parshas HaChodesh — the sanctification of Nisan as the first month (Shemos 12:1–20), read on the Shabbos before or on Rosh Chodesh Nisan Section 1 The matter of the Four Parshiyos that are read in Adar: the twelve months correspond to the twelve tribes of Y-H upon whom the holy kingship [ malchus d'kedushah ] stands — for the months are counted by the moon, which is the bechina (dimension/mode) of kingship, as is well known. And therefore the essential wholeness, fullness, and rectification of the months depends upon the rectification of the holy covenant [ tikun habris ] — for the essential blemish of the moon is through blemishing the covenant, as is known, in the bechina of yehee me'oros — me'oros written deficient, without a vav — the vav being the vitality and fullness, and the vav is the bechina of rectification of the covenant, as Rabbainu, of blessed memory, wrote (in §11). And when this vav — which is the bechina of the rectification of the covenant, which is the vitality — is absent, it is, G‑d forbid, me'oros deficient — which is the bechina of blemish and diminishment of the moon. And therefore there are twelve New Moons in the year corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-H, as stated — for Rosh Chodesh is the rectification of the moon, in the bechina of "bring atonement for Me [on account of the moon]" — for then the moon begins to fill, and the essential filling and rectification comes through the rectification of the covenant. Therefore there are twelve New Moons corresponding to the twelve tribes of Y-H — which is the bechina of the rectification of the covenant upon which the holy kingship stands. For the essential sustaining and standing of the holy kingship is through the rectification of the covenant, and corresponding to this there are twelve New Moons — which are an atonement for all their generations — for every bechina of rectification of the covenant within them brings about the rectification of the bechina of holy kingship, which is the bechina of the moon, as stated. And the wicked kingship — which is the blemish of the covenant — which is the kingship of Amalek, which is the filth of the serpent [ zuhamas hanachash ] — stands opposite holy kingship and always clings after holy kingship to suckle from it. And the essential sustenance [ yenikah — suckling] of the wicked is from the bechina of raglayin [the feet / lower extremities], in the bechina of "her legs, etc." — for the blemish of the covenant is the side of death [ sitra d'mosa ], and therefore Amalek always clings after the tribe of Dan — as it is written: "and he struck down all the stragglers at your rear" — as stated, all those who blemish the covenant. And as Rabbainu wrote on this in the teaching "U'v'yom HaBikkurim" (§56). For the tribe of Dan is the fourth and last of all the banners — for it gathers up all the camps, and it is the bechina of raglayin [the feet] — and therefore the kingship of Amalek clings behind it. And therefore, also in the bechina of the year, their essential strengthening is in the last season, which is the season of Teves — that is, the last three months of the year: Teves, Shvat, Adar — for the four seasons of the year of three months each correspond to the four banners into which the twelve tribes of Y-H were divided, as stated. Thus it emerges that their essential strengthening comes in the season of Teves, as stated. And this is the bechina of: "And Esther was taken to the king in the tenth month, which is the month of Teves" — for Esther is the bechina of holy kingship (as cited in the words of Rabbainu, of blessed memory). And the essential strengthening of the wicked [power] is in the last and final month of the entire year, which is the month of Adar — and therefore Haman, who is the wicked kingship, the kingship of Amalek, grew powerful then. And therefore in the month of Adar the Four Parshiyos are read — for they are the bechina of the rectification of holy kingship, which is the bechina of dalet [the letter dalet = four] (as Rabbainu wrote). For the essential standing of kingship is upon four banners and four seasons, a

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Chanukah Halachos1 6
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Chanukah Halachos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim III Halachos of Chanukah — §§1–6 From the works of Reb Noson of Breslov, of blessed memory, derived from the Torah of Rabbainu Nachman of Breslov, of blessed memory Halacha 1 — The Matter of Chanukah Based on Rabbainu's teaching beginning Achavay lan mena d'lo shavya l'chabbala — "Show us a vessel that has not been damaged" — in Likutay Moharan I, §25. See there. The principle is that every person must extract himself from the power of ha-m'damaeh — the imaginative faculty — which is the force of animalistic nature, which encompasses all of the desires. He must rise up to the intellect. See there. And thereafter, even as one breaks the imaginative faculty, when one returns to ascend from level to level, the imaginative faculty and all its confusions spread out again, and one must again subdue them. Subduing them is accomplished through the revelation of the greatness of the Creator — that is, through tzedakah (charity). See there. And this is the inner meaning of the verse, Hodu la-Shem kir'u vi'shmo — "Give thanks to the Lord, call upon His name" — which corresponds to ascending from the world of Action ( Asiyah ) to the world of Formation ( Yetzirah ). Therefore one mentions the greatness of the Creator in order to subdue them. See there. Section 1 This is the aspect of Chanukah — it is the first illumination of the entire year (as is brought in the holy books), and it alludes to the beginning of a person's initiation ( chinuch ) into Divine service. This is the meaning of the word Chanukah : that a person becomes initiated ( mitchanaych ) in the service of the Blessed Name. And one cannot begin the service of the Blessed Name except by first waging war to break the imaginative faculty, as described above. This is the aspect of the war against the wicked idol-worshippers that preceded Chanukah — the evil idolatrous empire that sought to cause Israel to forget the Torah of God and transgress the statutes of His will. This corresponds to the imaginative faculty, the animalistic power, which spreads over a person and seeks to prevent and divert him from the Torah of God, Heaven forbid, as it is written (Daniel 8): V'ha-tzafir ha-sa'ir — "And the hairy goat…" etc. And thereafter, when one merits to prevail over the aforementioned wicked empire and to break the imaginative faculty, one then begins to kindle the Chanukah lamp — that is, one merits to ascend to the intellect, which is the aspect of a burning lamp, as is explained in the teaching beginning Pasach Rabbi Shimon (§60). And one adds more each day, for it is forbidden to remain on a single level — rather, one must add in holiness each day, and one's intellect must increase and grow each day. This is why we add one more candle each time upon the previous one, and the first candle remains present through all the days — for when one kindles two candles on the second night, they correspond to the first and second nights; and so too on the third night; so it emerges that the first night's candle goes along with all the candles of all the nights. This corresponds to what Rabbainu wrote (§62) — that all beginnings are difficult, because one is going from one extreme to another; and thereafter, as one progresses and becomes more holy, all the service of all the days draws its strength from the beginning, and the power of the beginning accompanies all the days. This is the aspect of ta'anis , the aspect of the Divine Name Havayah spelled in reverse ( b'achorayim ), where the first letter accompanies all the letters — just as one writes: Yud-Yud , Yud-Kay , etc. This is the aspect of the Chanukah lights: at first one kindles one, then aleph-beis (one and two), then aleph-beis-gimel — so the first light goes with all the days, because all the days draw their strength from the beginning of the initiation of service, which was when one first began to rise to the intellect — that is the first candle of Chanukah. And thereafter, as one's intellect continues to increase each day, all the days draw their power from the beginning, for all beginnings are difficult, as above. And this is why we say Hallel on Chanukah — it is the aspect of praising the Blessed Name, in order to reveal the greatness of the Creator, in order to subdue the imaginative faculty that spreads anew each time one seeks to ascend from level to level, as above. Section 2 This is the aspect of the tzedakah — the practice of giving Chanukah money ( ma'os Chanukah ) generously to the poor — in order to break the imaginative faculty at each level through the revelation of colors, which is the aspect of the greatness of the Creator that is revealed through tzedakah , as above. And this is the aspect of the play ( s'chok ) that even the early righteous ones were accustomed to engage in during Chanukah — permissible forms of play. (However, in our many sins, people today come to transgression by playing forbidden games.) This

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Chol HaMoed 1
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Chol Hamoed Likutay Halachos · Orach Chaim Hilchos Chol HaMoed Lashon Targum , Nogah , and the Intermediate Days Halacha 1 The matter of Chol HaMoed , on which some labors are forbidden and some are permitted 1 For Chol HaMoed is the aspect of lashon Targum [the Aramaic language of translation] , which is the aspect of Nogah [the “glow” — the intermediate k’lipah between holiness and impurity] , which is the intermediary between Lashon HaKodesh [the Holy Tongue] and the other languages of the seventy nations. For Yom Tov is the aspect of the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh (as Rabainu of blessed memory wrote in siman 30): that Yom Tov is the aspect of raising Malchus of holiness from among the k’lipos and subduing the evil kingdom of the four kingdoms. This is the aspect of the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh , which is the aspect of Malchus Peh [the kingdom of the mouth / speech] , through which the evil kingdom of the seventy nations is subdued. And therefore the Yomim Tovim are called an os [a sign] , for they are the aspect of sh’miras habris [guarding the covenant] , which is achieved through the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh (as Rabainu wrote in the teaching “ T’fillah LaChavakuk ,” siman 19). And this is what we say on Yom Tov: “Who chose us from all the nations and elevated us above all languages” — as written above in Hilchos N’si’as Kapayim (siman 1). And Chol HaMoed comes after Yom Tov to complete Lashon HaKodesh . For the essential completeness of Lashon HaKodesh is through lashon Targum . And this is Chol HaMoed — which is a mixture of chol and Moed . For in the weekday ( chol ), the Sitra Achara holds sway — the aspect of the seventy nations. And the Moed [festival] is the aspect of the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh , as above. And Chol HaMoed is the intermediary between them — the aspect of Targum , as above. And therefore, some labors are forbidden and some are permitted — for it is mixed of weekday and festival, as above. 2 And therefore the matter was entrusted to the Sages — that they should choose which labors are forbidden and which are permitted, as found in the Poskim . This is the aspect of the Oral Torah , which is the aspect of lashon Targum , the aspect of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, the aspect of the six orders of the Mishnah — which are the aspect of kasher and pasul , forbidden and permitted, etc., as found in the Holy Zohar. And therefore Chol HaMoed , which is the aspect of Targum as above, was entrusted to the Sages — for it is the aspect of the Oral Torah, as above. And the general rule: all labors that are absolutely necessary — namely, for one’s sustenance, or a matter of irretrievable loss ( davar ha’avaid ), or the needs of honoring the Yom Tov — are permitted. And all other labors are forbidden on Chol HaMoed . For Chol HaMoed , which is the aspect of Targum , the aspect of Nogah — there is the essential battle and test and refining of each and every one of Yisrael. And whoever still holds onto this level must minimize and forbid upon himself all the labors, and not engage in anything except what is absolutely necessary for his sustenance, etc., as above. For this he is compelled to do in order to live and sustain himself. And this is what is hinted at by the fact that our Sages forbade all labors on Chol HaMoed and only permitted what is necessary, as above. But Yom Tov, which is the aspect of the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh and the complete nullification of evil — which is the aspect of one who has already merited to win the battle and merited sh’miras habris — therefore all labors are forbidden on it. For when evil is completely subdued, all the 39 labors are nullified, for they come from the filth of the serpent, which is the evil. And the essential thing depends on sh’miras habris , which is the aspect of the tal oros [the dew of lights] — the opposite of the 39 labors that come from [the filth of the serpent], etc. And therefore, in truth, one who holds onto the level of Yom Tov — namely, who has merited the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh and sh’miras habris — does not need to engage in any labor or commerce at all. And about him it is said: “And strangers shall stand and tend your flocks” (Yeshaya 61:5) , etc. And this is what is brought in the Holy Zohar: that Yom Tov is the aspect of the talmid chacham , and Chol HaMoed is the aspect of the students and those close to him. For the talmid chacham is the aspect of Yom Tov — for he has already merited to win the battle and merited sh’miras habris and the completeness of Lashon HaKodesh , which is the aspect of Yom Tov. But his people are the aspect of Chol HaMoed , which is the aspect of Targum , the aspect of Nogah — for t

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Chol HaMoed 2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Chol Hamoed Likutay Halachos · Orach Chaim Hilchos Chol HaMoed The Descent That Is the Purpose of the Ascent — Lost Sparks and Davar Ha’Avaid Halacha 2 On Chol HaMoed it is forbidden to perform all labors except the labor of davar ha’avaid [a matter of irretrievable loss] There is an allusion here: that one who wants to do t’shuvah must be expert in halacha — namely, expert in ratzo [running forth], expert in shov [returning] — the aspect of “entering and exiting” ( ayil v’nafik ). As Rabainu of blessed memory said in the teaching “Call Yehoshua,” etc., in siman 6; see there. 1 For this is among the ways of t’shuvah : that at first they draw him close from Above, and afterward they distance him and he has a descent. And then he must strengthen himself with whatever he can , and not let himself fall completely, G-d forbid. And then the descent is the purpose of the ascent, and he merits to return and ascend to holiness at an even higher level. And this is hinted at in the law of Chol HaMoed described above. For when one does t’shuvah and sanctifies oneself, this is the aspect of the holiness of Yom Tov — for Yom Tov is the aspect of t’shuvah (as Rabainu of blessed memory wrote). And after Yom Tov is Chol HaMoed . And Chol HaMoed is between one holiness and another — namely, between the holiness of the first days of Yom Tov and the last days. This is an allusion to the aspect of nafik [exiting] — namely, when one goes out and becomes distant from the holiness, the aspect of the above-mentioned descent. Then one also needs to sanctify oneself with the holiness of Yom Tov, even though one has fallen from one’s holiness to the aspect of chol [the mundane] . And this is the aspect of Chol HaMoed — that one must sanctify the aspect of the chol with the holiness of the Moed : to sanctify it from performing labor, which is the aspect of the physicality of worldly affairs. For the 39 labors are the filth of the serpent, and one must sanctify oneself from them even when one falls from the holiness of Yom Tov. And one should not let oneself fall to complete chol ; rather, one should be in the aspect of Chol HaMoed — sanctifying the aspect of the weekdays with the holiness of the festival, as above. Only they permitted him the labor of davar ha’avaid [a matter of irretrievable loss] . This is an allusion: that one should not descend and engage in physical affairs except for the sake of davar ha’avaid — namely, the aspect of lost things ( d’varim ha’avudim ). For there are many nitzotzos [holy sparks] that were lost and fell to where they fell through one’s sins. And for this reason, one fell from one’s level — so that one would be refined and purified in the lower levels, in order to elevate the sparks that fell there , which are the aspect of “lost things.” And this is what our Sages of blessed memory permitted — to perform the labor of davar ha’avaid on Chol HaMoed . Namely, that one should not perform any labor — meaning, physical affairs — except the labor of davar ha’avaid : that one should engage in this labor to rectify one’s lost things — for which reason one descended to these levels, as above. And then, when one sanctifies one’s fall with the holiness of Chol HaMoed as above, one returns to ascend and merits to return to the holiness of Yom Tov. And this is the aspect of the last days of Yom Tov — namely, the aspect of returning and ascending to holiness, in the aspect of “the descent is the purpose of the ascent.” For the last days of Yom Tov have an additional light beyond the first days. For example, on Sukkos , the last days are Sh’mini Atzeres and Simchas Torah , when is the essential delight and closeness of Yisrael to their Father in Heaven, as they said: “Please, remain with me one more day; your parting is difficult for me,” etc. And as is brought, the great value of the holiness of Sh’mini Atzeres and Simchas Torah . Also, the last days of Pesach : then was the Splitting of the Sea, and the plunder of the Sea was greater than the plunder of Mitzrayim , as it is written: “We shall make you circlets of gold with studs of silver” (Shir HaShirim 1:11) , as Rashi explained. And as our Sages of blessed memory said: “A maidservant saw at the Sea” [more than the prophet Yechezkel saw], etc. For this is the essential plunder of the Sea — that the sea of wisdom was split open for them and they merited great perceptions. It emerges that the last days have an additional light . This is an allusion that afterward, one merits extra holiness and great Daas when one returns and ascends from the descent, in the aspect of “the descent is the purpose of the ascent,” as abov

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Chol HaMoed 3
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Chol Hamoed Likutay Halachos · Orach Chaim Hilchos Chol HaMoed The Revelation of the Ratzon , the Maitzach HaNachash , and the Lost Souls Between Two Healings Halacha 3 The matter of Chol HaMoed , which falls between the first Yom Tov and the last Yom Tov, and most labors are forbidden on it while some are permitted — namely, davar ha’avaid , etc. (Based on Likutay Moharan II:4, “U’v’yom HaBikkurim” / “V’es HaOr’vim Tzivisi L’chalk’lecha”) For it is explained in the teaching “ U’v’yom HaBikkurim ” and “ V’es HaOr’vim Tzivisi L’chalk’lecha ” that through the Three R’galim, the Ratzon [Will] is revealed . For the Three R’galim call out and reveal that everything is conducted only according to His will, blessed be He, alone — and there is no compulsion of nature at all. And when the Ratzon is revealed, from this comes yirah [awe] , etc. And through the yirah , chesed [lovingkindness] flows, etc. And when one merits the flow of chesed , one does not need to perform any activity or business from the 39 labors, etc., for it is fulfilled: “And strangers shall stand and tend your flocks” (Yeshaya 61:5) , etc. But against the voice of the calling of Yom Tov that calls and reveals the Ratzon , there is the voice of the roaring of the evil beasts that trample and tear — which are the wise men of nature ( chachmay hateva ), etc. But the true wise men of the generation connect the Ratzon to the root of the Ratzon , which is the aspect of the Maitzach HaRatzon [the Forehead of Will] , etc. But there is the aspect of the Maitzach HaNachash [the Forehead of the Serpent] , the root of the wisdom of nature, etc. And one must subdue and topple it. And this is accomplished through tzedakah , etc. (See there all of this well.) But even when one subdues the root of the wisdom of nature through tzedakah , etc. — despite all this, when the revelation of the Ratzon is not yet strong and firm , they can still, G-d forbid, return and prevail, etc. And for this too, the power of tzedakah is needed, for tzedakah subdues them constantly. And one merits that the revelation of the Ratzon should strengthen and prevail, and the wisdom of nature should fall and be completely nullified. And then the voice of the calling of Yom Tov is heard, etc. And this is the essential joy of Yom Tov, etc. And then the chesed flows through the yirah , etc. And then one does not need to perform any business or any labor, etc., as above. (See there all of this well, in Likutay Moharan Tinyana, siman 4.) 1 And this is the aspect of Chol HaMoed . For on Yom Tov, when the Ratzon is revealed, and through the revelation of the Ratzon the chesed flows, and then one does not need to perform any business or any labor, etc., as above — therefore, all labors are forbidden on Yom Tov . For then all the labors are nullified through the revelation of the Ratzon , as above. 2 And therefore, the essential holiness of Yom Tov depends on Yisrael — namely, on the true wise men of the generation , who sanctify the month. And through this, Yom Tov is made — according to how they sanctify the month, as our Sages expounded: “These are the festivals of Hashem that you shall call them” (VaYikra 23:4) — “Do not read ‘ osam ’ [them] but ‘ atem ’ [you],” etc. For the essential holiness of Yom Tov, which is the revelation of the Ratzon , depends only on the true wise men of the generation, who have the power to connect the Ratzon to the root of the Ratzon , the aspect of the Maitzach HaRatzon — through which is the essential holiness of Yom Tov, which is the revelation of the Ratzon , as above. And this is why the Torah placed Shabbas before the Mo’adim and included Shabbas in the section of the festivals, as it is written: “These are the festivals of Hashem: six days you shall perform labor” (VaYikra 23:2-3) , etc. For the essential holiness of Yom Tov receives from Shabbas, as brought. As we say on Shabbas: “the beginning of the mikra’ay kodesh ” — Shabbas is the head and beginning of the mikra’ay kodesh . For all the mikra’ay kodesh receive their holiness from Shabbas. Namely, the essential holiness of Yom Tov is the aspect of mikra kodesh — calling and revealing the Ratzon above. This power is received only from Shabbas , which is the aspect of the root of the Ratzon , the aspect of the Maitzach HaRatzon , etc. — the aspect of the departure of Moshe on Shabbas at Minchah , etc. (as explained in the above teaching). And this is the aspect of “ M’kadaish HaShabbas v’Yisrael v’hazmanim ” [“Who sanctifies the Shabbas and Yisrael and the seasons”] — for Shabbas is established and standing

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Chol HaMoed 4
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Chol Hamoed Likutay Halachos · Orach Chaim Hilchos Chol HaMoed Halacha 4 Based on Likutay Moharan II:8, “Tik’u Tochachah” The matter of Chol HaMoed, which is forbidden in most labors, and nothing is permitted on it except for the sake of davar ha’avaid Based on the Torah “ Tik’u Tochachah ” in Likutay Tinyana, siman 8; see there well, the entire Torah from beginning to end. See there regarding the matter of the prayer in the aspect of din [judgment] of the Baal Koach [the man of great power], etc. For the essence of prayer is mercy and supplication, and the essence of mercy depends on Daas , etc. And sometimes, when the Sitra Achara suckles from the mercy, etc., then mercy is diminished among us, etc., and cruelty results, etc. And through this, Daas is blemished, etc. And then the Sitra Achara suckles in the aspect of “and the serpent was cunning” (B’raishis 3:1) . And from this comes, G-d forbid, the lust of adultery, etc. For there are three mochin [brains/intellects] that are the aspect of three partitions spread before this lust, etc. And they are the aspect of the three t’fillos , etc. And when Daas is blemished through the blemish of mercy as above, then the prayer is in the aspect of din , and the Sitra Achara swallows it, G-d forbid. And then one needs a great Baal Koach who will pray a prayer in the aspect of din like Pinchas, etc. — so that the prayer will stand in the gullet of the Sitra Achara when it wants to swallow this prayer, and then it must vomit everything, etc. — even its essential vitality, which is the aspect of gairim [converts], in the aspect of “the wealth he swallowed he shall vomit from his belly” (Iyov 20:15) , etc. And this is “VaY’fallail” (T’hillim 106:30) [“and he prayed” — regarding Pinchas], etc. And this is “You shattered the sea with Your might” (T’hillim 74:13) , etc. And this is the aspect of the Splitting of the Sea and the war of Amalek, through which “Yisro heard” (Sh’mos 18:1) and converted, etc. And this is the aspect of “thunders, clouds that pour water,” etc. — the aspect of the revelation of His glory, blessed be He. And through the kavod , prophecy is drawn. And through this, the m’dameh [imaginative faculty] is refined and one merits the faith of the creation of the world ( emunos chiddush ha’olam ), which is the aspect of the Hay of “ HaShishi ” (B’raishis 1:31) , etc. For the essential faith of the creation of the world was revealed through the Giving of the Torah, which is the aspect of all the levels of prophecy, etc. And through this faith, there will be the renewal of the world. And the renewal of the world will be in the aspect of Eretz Yisrael , in the aspect of hashgachah and wonders not according to the way of nature. And through this, a new song will be aroused — a song of wonders, which is the aspect of a simple, double, triple, quadruple song, etc. — that equals chesed , which is the aspect of the song that will be played on 72 strings (called s’trinus ), corresponding to the numerical value of chesed , in the aspect of “the world is built with chesed” (T’hillim 89:3) , etc. And this is the voice of the worthy rebuker ( mochiach ), through which specifically one can rebuke — for one arouses a good fragrance, etc., in the aspect of “my spikenard gave forth its fragrance” (Shir HaShirim 1:12) , etc. For through this voice, all the fragrances of Gan Aiden grow, for this voice waters the Garden in the aspect of “and a river goes out from Aiden to water the Garden” (B’raishis 2:10) , etc. (See there all of this well.) 1 And all the Yomim Tovim are a remembrance of the Exodus from Mitzrayim . And the essential Exodus from Mitzrayim was through the prayer of the Baal Koach in the aspect of din described above — which is the aspect of VaY’fallail , the aspect of “and cast [it] before Pharaoh; it shall become a serpent” (Sh’mos 7:9) — [the initials of whose Hebrew words spell VaY’fallail ] — the aspect of “You shattered the sea with Your might,” etc. Through this was the Exodus from Mitzrayim and the Splitting of the Sea, through which all the R’galim were sanctified, for they are all a remembrance of the Exodus from Mitzrayim . And therefore all the Yomim Tovim are forbidden in the performance of labor . For all the 39 labors have the serpent’s filth clinging to them, in the aspect of “and the serpent was cunning” described above — through which was decreed “by the sweat of your brow shall you eat bread” (B’raishis 3:19) , which is the aspect of all the exertions of all the affairs for the sake of livelihood, all of which are

teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - HoshanaRabbah Halachos1 2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Hoshanarabbah Halachos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Part III Laws of Hoshana Rabbah — Halachos 1 and 2 Key Terms Hoshana Rabbah The seventh day of Sukkos — the day before Shemini Atzeres. It is the day of the final sealing of the judgment begun on Rosh Hashanah and the completion of the great tikkun of the Yomim Nora'im. The aravos (willows) are taken and beaten on this day — a custom of the prophets. The Zohar teaches that on this day Yitzchak "returned and dug the wells of water" — meaning the hidden deep counsel is re-excavated and revealed. Aravay nachal (aravay nachal) Willows of the brook — as one of the four species, they correspond to netzach and hod (as is known), which are the aspects of aitzos (counsel/strategies). "Nachal" (brook) alludes to their connection to mayim (water) — the aspect of deep counsel: "Deep water is counsel in a person's heart" (Mishlei 20). On Hoshana Rabbah, the aravos are taken separately (beyond their role in the lulav bundle) — specifically as the aspect of the drawing of aitzos/counsel. Eitzos / aitzah (eitzos / aitzah) Counsel, strategies, divine guidance for how to conduct oneself — the central theme of Hoshana Rabbah §2. The completion of the entire process from Rosh Hashanah through Shemini Atzeres is the attainment of shleimus ha'aitzah — whole, undivided counsel. Hoshana Rabbah is the penultimate step: the aravos re-excavate the deep waters of aitzah so that on Shemini Atzeres malchus can be completed. Mayim amukim / mayim tehorim / may merivah "Deep waters" / "pure waters" / "waters of strife." Three interrelated images: (1) deep counsel hidden in the heart (Mishlei 20); (2) the pure waters of purification promised through Yechezkel ("I will sprinkle pure water upon you…"); (3) may merivah — the waters of strife that emerged specifically through the tzaddikim being challenged and opposed. These three are one: the pure waters of aitzah/da'as are drawn precisely through the opposition and strife the tzaddik endures, which drives him to deeper teshuvah. Motaros (motaros) Excesses, refuse — the overspill of the body's physicality (especially excessive eating) that rises to the brain and contaminates da'as, producing split and confused aitzah. Corresponds to the spiritual "sediment" produced by blemishing emunas chachamim. The purification process of Rosh Hashanah through Hoshana Rabbah is essentially the progressive removal of these motaros. Emunas chachamim (emunas chachamim) Faith in the sages/tzaddikim — the absolute foundation of Oral Torah, and the deepest tikkun of Adam haRishon's sin. The Rosh Hashanah–through–Shemini Atzeres cycle is described as the tikkun of Adam's sin, which was fundamentally a blemish of emunas chachamim (deviating from the true interpretation of Hashem's command, misled by the serpent's "counsel"). Without emunas chachamim, one cannot draw the pure waters of aitzah. Chosom b'soch chosom (chosom b'soch chosom) "A seal within a seal" — on Hoshana Rabbah the final seal is affixed, completing the process begun on Rosh Hashanah. The chosom (seal) itself is the aspect of emunah — as is known. The double seal (chosom within chosom) reflects the depth and finality of the judgment's completion. Vayashav Yitzchak / va'yachpor (vayashav Yitzchak / va'yachpor) "And Yitzchak returned and dug…" (Beraishis 26) — the Zohar teaches that the Hoshana Rabbah liturgy spiritually re-enacts Yitzchak's re-digging of the wells. Yitzchak = Pachad Yitzchak = the aspect of awe/din from which deep counsel is revealed. "Revealing the deep from darkness" (Iyov 12). The wells dug by the Avos — repeatedly stopped up by the Philistines (= forces of opposition to holiness) and re-dug by Yitzchak — are the aspect of the may merivah that are attained again and again through teshuvah in the face of opposition. Shemini Atzeres / Simchas Torah The eighth day of assembly — the ultimate culmination and tikkun. Israel stands alone with Hashem (katan v'gol — small gathering, intimate). The tikkun of malchus is completed. On Simchas Torah, the Torah scroll is completed and begun again — every Jew goes up to the Torah — all portions of Torah are included together — Torah ascends to its root in supernal chachmah. Then "light of the tzaddikim rejoices" — the aspect of "chadi Rabbi Shimon." Sukkas shalom (sukkas sholom) "The sukkah of peace" — the aspect of the tikkun of da'as accomplished after the pure waters are revealed. When the pure waters of aitzah emerge through teshuvah from the strife and opposition, the strife is itself rectified and becomes peace — "spread over us the sukkah of Your peace and direct us with good counsel from before You." teachings.title: Likutay Halachos - Lulav Halachos1 2
teachings.content: Likutay Halachos Orach Chaim 3 - Lulav Halachos Likutay Halachos — Orach Chaim, Part III Laws of Lulav and Esrog — Halachos 1 and 2 Key Terms Esrog (esrog) The citron — "the fruit of a beautiful tree" (Vayikra 23). The fourth of the four species. Corresponds to malchus (kingship), Knesses Yisrael (the collective soul of Israel), and the bat ayin (pupil of the eye) — which encompasses and unifies all the "colors" of the other three species. Here: the aspect of Hashem's hispa'airus (glorification/beautification) through Israel. Hispa'airus (hispa'airus) Glorification, beauty, splendor — specifically Hashem's glorification through Israel. The esrog is "pri aytz hadar" — the fruit of the beautiful/glorious tree — alluding to this hispa'airus. Each person of Israel, even a sinner, provides hispa'airus to Hashem as long as the name "Israel" is upon him. Tlas gevonin d'eina / bas ayin Aramaic: "the three colors of the eye" (white, iris, pupil) — and "the daughter of the eye" (pupil). A Kabbalistic image from the Zohar: the four species correspond to the four elements of the eye — three colors (lulav, hadas, aravah) are gathered separately, and then the esrog (pupil) unifies them all, for the pupil contains and encompasses all the colors. Ritzonos (ritzonos) Divine will/desires — the hidden intentions behind every created thing. Through the hispa'airus found in each Jew, the tzaddik discovers and reveals Hashem's ritzonos within all of creation. Pachad Yitzchak "The fear of Isaac" — the divine attribute of yirah (awe/fear) associated with Rosh Hashanah, when Hashem "dresses in His garments of glorification" and awe falls upon all creation. Shem Havayah (Shem Havayah) The Divine Name — the four letters of which correspond to the four species. After Yom Kippur, through forgiveness and atonement, the Name is "enlarged" and one merits the mitzvah of esrog and the four species, which correspond to the Divine Name. Pear tachas efer "Beauty/glory in place of ashes" (Yeshayahu 61) — the tikkun of grief and mourning over the Churban (destruction of the Bais Hamikdash): when Israel weeps and mourns, Hashem transforms the ashes of exile into glory and splendor. This is the path to the esrog. Aravos nachal (aravay nachal) Willows of the brook — one of the four species. Here: the aspect of the "submerged good" hidden among the nations and among sinners of Israel, who have no taste (Torah) and no fragrance (mitzvos) — yet contain buried sparks of sanctity that return through teshuvah and conversion. Hadas (hadas) Myrtle — the species possessing fragrance (raiach). Corresponds to the shleimus (completion) of the mizbaich (altar), the aspect of "aishes raiach nichoach" (a pleasing fragrance to Hashem), accomplished through gairim (converts) and the souls of Israel returning from exile. The Avos (Patriarchs) were compared to the triple-leaved hadas because they brought converts. Aveer (aveer) "Air" — but here: the pure, serene spiritual atmosphere created by tzedakah and peace among people. When the aveer is pure and clear, a holy voice (kol) can travel far — drawing distant souls close and enabling converts to hear and come. Keren hashofar / keren hakayemes "The horn of the shofar" / "the enduring horn" — tzedakah is called "the enduring horn" (Tehillim 112). The shofar horn is formed from the "enduring horn" of tzedakah: when tzedakah creates the pure aveer, the holy voice of shofar travels far, gathering the dispersed. Yom ginusiya d'malka Aramaic: "the birthday/coronation day of the King" — Rosh Hashanah, when malchus is born/revealed, and Hashem dresses in glory, receiving hispa'airus from Israel. Mizbaich (mizbaich) The altar — its shleimus (completion) is achieved through eating in holiness (tikun ha'achilah) and through gairim (converts). The 70 bulls of Sukkos are offered on behalf of the 70 nations, so that goodness may be refined from them — which are the gairim.
